quote: And let me make this very clear - unlike President Obama, I will not raise taxes on the middle class. As president, I will protect the sanctity of life. I will honor the institution of marriage. And I will guarantee America's first liberty: the freedom of religion.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: My wife needs her freedom just like me.
author: Clive Owen

quote: Anything outside marriage seems like freedom and excitement.
author: Jeanette Winterson

quote: But I do believe that a woman's truest place is in a home, with a husband and with children, and with large freedom, pecuniary freedom, personal freedom, and the right to vote.
author: Lucy Stone

quote: We call that person who has lost his father, an orphan and a widower that man who has lost his wife. But that man who has known the immense unhappiness of losing a friend, by what name do we call him? Here every language is silent and holds its peace in impotence.
author: Joseph Roux

quote: Experts on romance say for a happy marriage there has to be more than a passionate love. For a lasting union, they insist, there must be a genuine liking for each other. Which, in my book, is a good definition for friendship.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: Friendship is two-sided. It isn't a friend just because someone's doing something nice for you. That's a nice person. There's friendship when you do for each other. It's like marriage - it's two-sided.
author: John Wooden

quote: Friendship is the marriage of the soul, and this marriage is liable to divorce.
author: Voltaire

quote: Marriage: A friendship recognized by the police.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quote: If there is such a thing as a good marriage, it is because it resembles friendship rather than love.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: Even in the common affairs of life, in love, friendship, and marriage, how little security have we when we trust our happiness in the hands of others!
author: William Hazlitt

quote: Marriage is the highest state of friendship. If happy, it lessens our cares by dividing them, at the same time that it doubles our pleasures by mutual participation.
author: Samuel Richardson

quote: My second husband believed I had such a fickle attitude to friendship that each Friday he would update the list of my 'Top Ten' friends in the manner of a Top Of The Pops chart countdown.
author: Julie Burchill

quote: Marriage, for a woman at least, hampers the two things that made life to me glorious - friendship and learning.
author: Jane Harrison

quote: A successful man is one who makes more money than his wife can spend. A successful woman is one who can find such a man.
author: Lana Turner

quote: My most brilliant achievement was my ability to be able to persuade my wife to marry me.
author: Winston Churchill

quote: I haven't spoken to my wife in years. I didn't want to interrupt her.
author: Rodney Dangerfield

quote: I'm not a real movie star. I've still got the same wife I started out with twenty-eight years ago.
author: Will Rogers

quote: Marriage is a wonderful institution, but who would want to live in an institution?
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: One man's folly is another man's wife.
author: Helen Rowland

quote: Don't forget Mother's Day. Or as they call it in Beverly Hills, Dad's Third Wife Day.
author: Jay Leno

quote: Brought up to respect the conventions, love had to end in marriage. I'm afraid it did.
author: Bette Davis

quote: I've never been married, but I tell people I'm divorced so they won't think something's wrong with me.
author: Elayne Boosler

quote: I have yet to hear a man ask for advice on how to combine marriage and a career.
author: Gloria Steinem

quote: I like marriage. The idea.
author: Toni Morrison

quote: In Hollywood a marriage is a success if it outlasts milk.
author: Rita Rudner

quote: My wife has a slight impediment in her speech. Every now and then she stops to breathe.
author: Jimmy Durante

quote: I'm going to marry a Jewish woman because I like the idea of getting up Sunday morning and going to the deli.
author: Michael J. Fox

quote: The way taxes are, you might as well marry for love.
author: Joe E. Lewis

quote: If man knew how women pass the time when they are alone, they'd never marry.
author: O. Henry

quote: Here in Hollywood you can actually get a marriage license printed on an Etch-A-Sketch.
author: Dennis Miller

quote: I'm the only man in the world with a marriage licence made out to whom it may concern.
author: Mickey Rooney

quote: It's a funny thing that when a man hasn't anything on earth to worry about, he goes off and gets married.
author: Robert Frost

quote: They say Yogi Berra is funny. Well, he has a lovely wife and family, a beautiful home, money in the bank, and he plays golf with millionaires. What's funny about that?
author: Casey Stengel

quote: I gave a funny speech at my wife's birthday party, and I'm thinking, 'Hey, I've still got it.'
author: Larry David

quote: The funny thing is I'm not bothered or sad about being on my own - after all I've never had a husband.
author: Francesca Annis

quote: You know what's funny? I don't ever feel the need to escape. I have a strong marriage. I like my life. You hear about these guys having midlife crises - I don't see that happening to me.
author: Harry Connick, Jr.

quote: At home in L.A., Sunday is lazy. It's the wife and me lying in bed with coffee, watching 'The Soup' or something funny on TiVo. The kid will occasionally join us. Eventually, breakfast is at a place down the street called Paty's. And we always have some kind of great dinner - my wife makes a great roast beef.
author: Eric McCormack

quote: For years I used to bore my wife over lunch with stories about funny incidents.
author: James Herriot

quote: 'Married with Children' was racy. It was sexist. It was a lot of things, but mostly it was funny.
author: Katey Sagal

quote: Also, in a funny way, if you have been happily married there are no unresolved areas, nothing to prove to yourself after the other dies.
author: Nigella Lawson

quote: It's funny - I read that women look to chiseled-faced guys for one-night stands, and to round-faced guys for marriage. When I'm rounder in the face, I like to say, 'This is my long-term look.' Or 'This is my wife-and-kids look right here.'
author: Garrett Hedlund

quote: What's funny is my husband doesn't have any tattoos at all, so he must be the very conservative one.
author: Ashley Scott

quote: I mean, I'm married first of all to one of, if not the most wonderful women in the world. She is everything - funny, attractive, hard-working, she has integrity, she loves me to bits.
author: Seal

quote: All I can say is that I'm getting married in the future. I've narrowed it down to that.
author: Tiger Woods

quote: We go on dates thinking that person is our future husband or wife, without getting to know them, as we live in a fantasy and an illusion of romance.
author: Patti Stanger

quote: I have not made any plans for the future, and my wife would kill me if I announced anything before that.
author: Scott Walker

quote: I'm on a search for my future ex-wife.
author: Richie Sambora

quote: When I was 17, I broke up with my future wife.
author: Kris Allen

quote: My hobbies are cooking and gardening, especially growing orchids. I love soccer, my husband and I support a British team called Chelsea, and I also enjoy tennis. We have 3 cats.
author: Juliet Mills

quote: By all means, marry. If you get a good wife, you'll become happy if you get a bad one, you'll become a philosopher.
author: Socrates

quote: A good wife is one who serves her husband in the morning like a mother does, loves him in the day like a sister does and pleases him like a prostitute in the night.
author: Chanakya

quote: A good marriage would be between a blind wife and a deaf husband.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: No man succeeds without a good woman behind him. Wife or mother, if it is both, he is twice blessed indeed.
author: Godfrey Winn

quote: Every good relationship, especially marriage, is based on respect. If it's not based on respect, nothing that appears to be good will last very long.
author: Amy Grant

quote: My advice to you is get married: if you find a good wife you'll be happy if not, you'll become a philosopher.
author: Socrates

quote: There is no more lovely, friendly and charming relationship, communion or company than a good marriage.
author: Martin Luther

quote: Sometimes I think my husband is so amazing that I don't know why he's with me. I don't know whether I'm good enough. But if I make him happy, then I'm everything I want to be.
author: Angelina Jolie

quote: Many a good hanging prevents a bad marriage.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: A good husband is never the first to go to sleep at night or the last to awake in the morning.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: Experts on romance say for a happy marriage there has to be more than a passionate love. For a lasting union, they insist, there must be a genuine liking for each other. Which, in my book, is a good definition for friendship.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: There is no lonelier man in death, except the suicide, than that man who has lived many years with a good wife and then outlived her. If two people love each other there can be no happy end to it.
author: Ernest Hemingway

quote: Marriage is good enough for the lower classes: they have facilities for desertion that are denied to us.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: I guess the real reason that my wife and I had children is the same reason that Napoleon had for invading Russia: it seemed like a good idea at the time.
author: Bill Cosby

quote: All you need for happiness is a good gun, a good horse, and a good wife.
author: Daniel Boone

quote: If there is such a thing as a good marriage, it is because it resembles friendship rather than love.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: All married couples should learn the art of battle as they should learn the art of making love. Good battle is objective and honest - never vicious or cruel. Good battle is healthy and constructive, and brings to a marriage the principles of equal partnership.
author: Ann Landers

quote: I have good looking kids. Thank goodness my wife cheats on me.
author: Rodney Dangerfield

quote: Of all the home remedies, a good wife is best.
author: Kin Hubbard

quote: Marriage is a very good thing, but I think it's a mistake to make a habit out of it.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: A man is in general better pleased when he has a good dinner upon his table, than when his wife talks Greek.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: A good husband makes a good wife.
author: John Florio

quote: Now I need to take a piece of wood and make it sound like the railroad track, but I also had to make it beautiful and lovable so that a person playing it would think of it in terms of his mistress, a bartender, his wife, a good psychiatrist - whatever.
author: Les Paul

quote: Anyone who thinks that the vice-president can take a position independent of the president of his administration simply has no knowledge of politics or government. You are his choice in a political marriage, and he expects your absolute loyalty.
author: Hubert H. Humphrey

quote: Government shouldn't tell you whom to marry.
author: Michael Bloomberg

quote: President Bush once said that marriage is a sacred institution and should be reserved for the union of one man and one woman. If this is the case - and most Americans would agree with him on this - then I have to ask: Why is the government at all involved in marrying people?
author: Tony Campolo

quote: If marriage really is a sacred institution, then why is the government controlling it, especially in a nation that affirms separation of church and state?
author: Tony Campolo

quote: This is how psychiatry has functioned-as a kind of property arm of the government, who can put you away if your husband doesn't like you.
author: Kate Millett

quote: Everybody wants you to do good things, but in a small town you pretty much graduate and get married. Mostly you marry, have children and go to their football games.
author: Faith Hill

quote: I dropped out of school for a semester, transferred to another college, switched to an art major, graduated, got married, and for a while worked as a graphic designer.
author: James Green Somerville

quote: My father was on the faculty in the Chemistry Department of Harvard University my mother had one year of graduate work in physics before her marriage.
author: Kenneth G. Wilson

quote: I love being married. It's so great to find that one special person you want to annoy for the rest of your life.
author: Rita Rudner

quote: Marriage is a great institution, but I'm not ready for an institution.
author: Mae West

quote: I have noticed... that men usually leave married women alone and are inclined to treat all wives with respect. This is no great credit to married women.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: Like me, the great majority of Americans wish both to preserve the traditional definition of marriage and to oppose bias and intolerance directed towards gays and lesbians.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: Show me a great actor and I'll show you a lousy husband. Show me a great actress, and you've seen the devil.
author: W. C. Fields

quote: Marriage is a great institution.
author: Elizabeth Taylor

quote: Almost no one is foolish enough to imagine that he automatically deserves great success in any field of activity yet almost everyone believes that he automatically deserves success in marriage.
author: Sydney J. Harris

quote: Rude contact with facts chased my visions and dreams quickly away, and in their stead I beheld the horrors, the corruption, the evils and hypocrisy of society, and as I stood among them, a young wife, a great wail of agony went out from my soul.
author: Victoria Woodhull

quote: He that hath wife and children hath given hostages to fortune for they are impediments to great enterprises, either of virtue or mischief.
author: Francis Bacon

quote: I have great hopes that we shall love each other all our lives as much as if we had never married at all.
author: Lord Byron

quote: Women who marry early are often overly enamored of the kind of man who looks great in wedding pictures and passes the maid of honor his telephone number.
author: Anna Quindlen

quote: We should all aspire in life to do a multitude of things well - to be a great father, to be a good husband, to be a good lover, you know, to try to do things the best you can is very important to me.
author: Matthew Modine

quote: Marriage is the most natural state of man, and... the state in which you will find solid happiness.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: All you need for happiness is a good gun, a good horse, and a good wife.
author: Daniel Boone

quote: Even in the common affairs of life, in love, friendship, and marriage, how little security have we when we trust our happiness in the hands of others!
author: William Hazlitt

quote: Nothing flatters a man as much as the happiness of his wife he is always proud of himself as the source of it.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: I am about to be married, and am of course in all the misery of a man in pursuit of happiness.
author: Lord Byron

quote: Happiness in marriage is entirely a matter of chance.
author: Jane Austen

quote: My whole working philosophy is that the only stable happiness for mankind is that it shall live married in blessed union to woman-kind - intimacy, physical and psychical between a man and his wife. I wish to add that my state of bliss is by no means perfect.
author: David Herbert Lawrence

quote: Always remember that the most important thing in a good marriage is not happiness, but stability.
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

quote: Getting married, for me, was the best thing I ever did. I was suddenly beset with an immense sense of release, that we have something more important than our separate selves, and that is the marriage. There's immense happiness that can come from working towards that.
author: Nick Cave

quote: I think people really marry far too much it is such a lottery after all, and for a poor woman a very doubtful happiness.
author: Queen Victoria

quote: I've often thought if I didn't make my marriage work, I would have failed at my one true shot at happiness.
author: Bethenny Frankel

quote: Happiness does not come from football awards. It's terrible to correlate happiness with football. Happiness comes from a good job, being able to feed your wife and kids. I don't dream football, I dream the American dream - two cars in a garage, be a happy father.
author: Barry Sanders

quote: Happiness is not that easy to achieve, but having a handsome husband, a beautiful baby, and a great job helps.
author: Ellen Pompeo

quote: To seduce a woman famous for strict morals, religious fervor and the happiness of her marriage: what could possibly be more prestigious?
author: Christopher Hampton

quote: You know, American citizens, I don't think, ever thought that the right to the pursuit of happiness did not include the right to marry the person you love. But for a whole number of Americans, gay Americans, that happens to be true.
author: Andrew Sullivan

quote: Marriage is wild. I thought it was this perfect land of happiness and joy. Wrong! After you say you do, you don't for a long time.
author: John Leguizamo

quote: The thing is, when I had my first success it did coincide with the end of my first marriage, and because I went on to have a very, very unhappy two years, I don't think I equate career success with personal happiness.
author: Rob Brydon

quote: I've done an informal, anecdotal survey about marriage, and I've found no evidence that it brings happiness.

quote: I find happiness comes from numerous sources in my life. Most often, the happy moments I cherish most are quiet moments with my wife and family back home in Nova Scotia.
author: Peter MacKay

quote: If we did not look to marriage as the principal source of happiness, fewer marriages would end in tears.

quote: I always remembered that when I saw people get married they got on a rocketship and went to Planet Happiness, Population: Them.

quote: It is not only my laboratory and my place of work but also my home, so that on the 30th October I was able to share my happiness immediately with my students and collaborators and, at the same time, with my wife and family.
author: George Porter

author: Cyril Connolly

quote: There are all kinds of things you can do to marry literacy with health.
author: C. Everett Koop

quote: For that story, I took as my subject a young woman whom I got to know over the course of a couple of visits. I never saw her having any health problems - but I knew she wanted to be married.

quote: My daily schedule is quite hectic, but I have to put my health first in order to be the best mom and wife I can be.
author: Ellen Pompeo

quote: The truth is that stress doesn't come from your boss, your kids, your spouse, traffic jams, health challenges, or other circumstances. It comes from your thoughts about these circumstances.

quote: In my case, I pay a standard premium to participate in the Federal Employees' Health Benefits Plan for my wife and myself out of each month's paycheck.
author: Virgil Goode

quote: My health is wonderful. I work out. I'm working. Playing music. I have a beautiful wife, a nice home, a nice car, I got money in the bank. I got three beautiful dogs that love me. Like I said, I'm blessed. I survived.

quote: Hubert Humphrey talks so fast that listening to him is like trying to read Playboy magazine with your wife turning the pages.
author: Barry Goldwater

quote: Love is more pleasant than marriage for the same reason that novels are more amusing than history.
author: Nicolas Chamfort

quote: When the rose and the cross are united the alchemical marriage is complete and the drama ends. Then we wake from history and enter eternity.
author: Robert Anton Wilson

quote: Since the dawn of time, traditional marriage - the union between one man and one woman - has been the building block of civilization, and at no point in our nation's history has that foundation been under more severe attack than now.

quote: A man's home is his wife's castle.
author: Alexander Chase

quote: Let the wife make the husband glad to come home, and let him make her sorry to see him leave.
author: Martin Luther

quote: I believe the home and marriage is the foundation of our society and must be protected.

quote: Of all the home remedies, a good wife is best.

author: Jackie Kennedy

quote: At every party there are two kinds of people - those who want to go home and those who don't. The trouble is, they are usually married to each other.

quote: We live in grief for having left the womb, for having left the teat, then school, then home. In my case, it was leaving marriages, and the death of my wife.

quote: If you go away on location for three months and your wife stays at home, you've made a whole new load of friends and she's made a whole new load of friends and you get home and you're kind of strangers.

quote: A happy home is one in which each spouse grants the possibility that the other may be right, though neither believes it.

quote: I could lie and say my wife cooks for me, but she doesn't. My wife has never learnt cooking but she has great cooks at home.

author: Hesiod

quote: I have been alone since my husband died. I stay in my home. I don't date. It's hard to date when you're at home. Nobody knows you.

quote: My wife was delighted with the home I had given her amid the prairies of the far west.

quote: But I do believe that a woman's truest place is in a home, with a husband and with children, and with large freedom, pecuniary freedom, personal freedom, and the right to vote.

quote: A good wife is someone who thinks she has done everything right: raising the kids, being there for the husband, being home, trying to do it all.

quote: There's nothing like a good cheating song to make me want to run home to be with my wife.

quote: I'm kind of a homebody. My husband says I like to just stay home and do nothing, but that's just how I am.

quote: During the periods in my marriage when I chose to stay home with my kids rather than work as an attorney, it caused me no end of anxiety. Despite the fact that I knew I was contributing to our family by caring for our children, I still felt that my worth was less because I wasn't earning.

quote: I know this sounds generic, but I'm so happy to be home with my husband, my family, and my dog.

author: John Gay

author: Rodney Dangerfield

quote: No jealousy their dawn of love overcast, nor blasted were their wedded days with strife each season looked delightful as it past, to the fond husband and the faithful wife.

quote: Adam knew Eve his wife and she conceived. It is a pity that this is still the only knowledge of their wives at which some men seem to arrive.

quote: It is sad that the Republican leadership is not as interested as they say they are in protecting the institution of marriage as they are in waging a campaign to divide and distract the American people from the real issues that need to be addressed.
author: Kendrick Meek

quote: Each experience I go through - marriage, my public life, my personal life - I'm learning as I go.

quote: Everything in life is a lesson and I have learned from each marriage. Yes, I've made mistakes but every experience is a learning curve.

author: Sol Wachtler

quote: I hope gay marriage will be legal in every state.

quote: In places where marriage's core meaning has been altered through legal action, officials are beginning to target for punishment those believers and churches that refuse to adapt.

quote: I guess I have always been deeply terrified to really be someone's wife since I know from life one cannot love another, ever, really.

author: Joseph Campbell

author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: It is most unwise for people in love to marry.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: To keep your marriage brimming, With love in the loving cup, Whenever you're wrong, admit it Whenever you're right, shut up.

quote: Love: A temporary insanity curable by marriage.

quote: I do not want a husband who honours me as a queen, if he does not love me as a woman.
author: Elizabeth I

quote: When marrying, ask yourself this question: Do you believe that you will be able to converse well with this person into your old age? Everything else in marriage is transitory.

author: Oscar Wilde

quote: If I get married, I want to be very married.

author: Henny Youngman

quote: A dress that zips up the back will bring a husband and wife together.

author: Honore de Balzac

quote: If you want to sacrifice the admiration of many men for the criticism of one, go ahead, get married.

author: John Steinbeck

author: Erma Bombeck

quote: A man in love is incomplete until he has married. Then he's finished.
author: Zsa Zsa Gabor

quote: Never get married in college it's hard to get a start if a prospective employer finds you've already made one mistake.
author: Elbert Hubbard

quote: He's the kind of man a woman would have to marry to get rid of.
author: Mae West

author: Ogden Nash

quote: Love: A temporary insanity curable by marriage.
author: Ambrose Bierce

author: Sydney Smith

quote: When a man opens a car door for his wife, it's either a new car or a new wife.
author: Prince Philip

quote: Marriage, n: the state or condition of a community consisting of a master, a mistress, and two slaves, making in all, two.
author: Ambrose Bierce

quote: Marriage is an adventure, like going to war.
author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quote: Strike an average between what a woman thinks of her husband a month before she marries him and what she thinks of him a year afterward, and you will have the truth about him.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: Men have a much better time of it than women. For one thing, they marry later for another thing, they die earlier.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: Well married a person has wings, poorly married shackles.
author: Henry Ward Beecher

quote: The big difference between sex for money and sex for free is that sex for money usually costs a lot less.
author: Brendan Behan

quote: Marriage is a series of desperate arguments people feel passionately about.
author: Katharine Hepburn

quote: I think women are natural caretakers. They take care of everybody. They take care of their husbands and their kids and their dogs, and don't spend a lot of time just getting back and taking time out.
author: Reese Witherspoon

quote: Bachelors have consciences, married men have wives.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: It's not beauty but fine qualities, my girl, that keep a husband.
author: Euripides

author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: An ideal wife is one who remains faithful to you but tries to be just as charming as if she weren't.
author: Sacha Guitry

author: Barbra Streisand

quote: Do not put such unlimited power into the hands of husbands. Remember all men would be tyrants if they could.
author: Abigail Adams

quote: The concept of two people living together for 25 years without a serious dispute suggests a lack of spirit only to be admired in sheep.
author: A. P. Herbert

quote: The majority of husbands remind me of an orangutan trying to play the violin.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: Marriage is like a cage one sees the birds outside desperate to get in, and those inside equally desperate to get out.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: A wedding is a funeral where you smell your own flowers.

quote: Marriage is a bribe to make the housekeeper think she's a householder.

quote: A happy marriage is a long conversation which always seems too short.
author: Andre Maurois

quote: Marriage is nature's way of keeping us from fighting with strangers.

quote: Marriage is a wonderful invention: then again, so is a bicycle repair kit.

quote: Happiness in marriage is entirely a matter of chance.

quote: Love is often the fruit of marriage.

quote: It is a full time job being honest one moment at a time, remembering to love, to honor, to respect. It is a practice, a discipline, worthy of every moment.
author: Jasmine Guy

quote: Marriage, a market which has nothing free but the entrance.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: They dream in courtship, but in wedlock wake.
author: Alexander Pope

quote: The bonds of matrimony are like any other bonds - they mature slowly.

quote: Marriage is a feast where the grace is sometimes better than the dinner.

quote: She's been married so many times she has rice marks on her face.

quote: Marriage is good for those who are afraid to sleep alone at night.
author: St. Jerome

quote: Marriage is the alliance of two people, one of whom never remembers birthdays and the other who never forgets them.

quote: He that loves not his wife and children feeds a lioness at home, and broods a nest of sorrows.

quote: Marriage is an attempt to solve problems together which you didn't even have when you were on your own.

quote: Marriage is not about age it's about finding the right person.

quote: I married the first man I ever kissed. When I tell this to my children, they just about throw up.

quote: Marriage: A word which should be pronounced 'mirage'.

quote: In olden times sacrifices were made at the altar - a practice which is still continued.

quote: I've had an exciting time I married for love and got a little money along with it.

quote: Faithful women are all alike, they think only of their fidelity, never of their husbands.

quote: I don't think my wife likes me very much, when I had a heart attack she wrote for an ambulance.

quote: On rare occasions one does hear of a miraculous case of a married couple falling in love after marriage, but on close examination it will be found that it is a mere adjustment to the inevitable.

quote: Never feel remorse for what you have thought about your wife she has thought much worse things about you.

quote: Marrying a man is like buying something you've been admiring for a long time in a shop window. You may love it when you get it home, but it doesn't always go with everything else in the house.

quote: Love in marriage should be the accomplishment of a beautiful dream, and not, as it too often is, the end.

quote: When I get married, it'll be no secret.

quote: Never tell a secret to a bride or a groom wait until they have been married longer.
author: E. W. Howe

quote: Marriage is the highest state of friendship. If happy, it lessens our cares by dividing them, at the same time that it doubles our pleasures by mutual participation.
author: Samuel Richardson

quote: When you have a baby, love is automatic, when you get married, love is earned.

quote: I like getting married, but I don't like being married.

quote: Sensual pleasures have the fleeting brilliance of a comet a happy marriage has the tranquillity of a lovely sunset.

quote: I enjoy being single, but I loved being married.

quote: Marriage is a gamble, let's be honest.

quote: Marriage is a mistake every man should make.

author: George Jessel

quote: If it were not for the presents, an elopement would be preferable.
author: George Ade

author: Robert Graves

quote: The critical period of matrimony is breakfast-time.

quote: Marriage is an exercise in torture.

author: John Gay

quote: I might be celibate, but I appreciate the wonder of the sacrament of marriage.
author: Keith O'Brien

quote: The only good husbands stay bachelors: They're too considerate to get married.

quote: One was never married, and that's his hell another is, and that's his plague.

quote: I very much feel that marriage is a sacrament and that sacrament should extend... to that legal entity of a union between what traditionally in our Western values has been defined as between a man and a woman.

quote: I married beneath me, all women do.
author: Nancy Astor

quote: I think it's something that needs to be said - that there are interracial marriages out there, and the couples live happy lives, and there's nothing wrong with it.

author: Jane Harrison

quote: I wanted to marry a girl just like my mom.

quote: Marriage is a financial contract I have enough contracts already.
author: Linda Fiorentino

quote: Marriage is the most natural state of man, and... the state in which you will find solid happiness.

quote: As to marriage or celibacy, let a man take which course he will, he will be sure to repent.
author: Socrates

quote: Marriage destroyed my relationship with two wonderful men.

quote: Experts on romance say for a happy marriage there has to be more than a passionate love. For a lasting union, they insist, there must be a genuine liking for each other. Which, in my book, is a good definition for friendship.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: Marriage is popular because it combines the maximum of temptation with the maximum of opportunity.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: Marriage is good enough for the lower classes: they have facilities for desertion that are denied to us.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: There is no subject on which more dangerous nonsense is talked and thought than marriage.
author: George Bernard Shaw

author: Mitt Romney

quote: Marriage is an act of will that signifies and involves a mutual gift, which unites the spouses and binds them to their eventual souls, with whom they make up a sole family - a domestic church.

quote: I think that gay marriage should be between a man and a woman.

quote: My decision to end my marriage was such a risk to lose ratings and lose my fan base. I had to take that risk for my inner peace and to be happy with myself.
author: Kim Kardashian

author: Voltaire

quote: Friendship is the marriage of the soul, and this marriage is liable to divorce.
author: Voltaire

quote: My view is that marriage is a relationship between a man and a woman. That's the position I've had for some time, and I don't intend to make any adjustments at this point... Or ever, by the way.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: Marriage is for women the commonest mode of livelihood, and the total amount of undesired sex endured by women is probably greater in marriage than in prostitution.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: Marriage is a wonderful institution, but who would want to live in an institution?
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: I'm not for gay marriage, but I'm not for discriminating against people.
author: Joel Osteen

quote: Marriage is like putting your hand into a bag of snakes in the hope of pulling out an eel.
author: Leonardo da Vinci

quote: Marriage: A friendship recognized by the police.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quote: You can forgive people who do not follow you through a philosophical disquisition but to find your wife laughing when you had tears in your eyes, or staring when you were in a fit of laughter, would go some way towards a dissolution of the marriage.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quote: Whenever a husband and wife begin to discuss their marriage they are giving evidence at a coroner's inquest.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: Marriage is not a noun it's a verb. It isn't something you get. It's something you do. It's the way you love your partner every day.
author: Barbara de Angelis

quote: All married couples should learn the art of battle as they should learn the art of making love. Good battle is objective and honest - never vicious or cruel. Good battle is healthy and constructive, and brings to a marriage the principles of equal partnership.
author: Ann Landers

quote: Marriage is one long conversation, chequered by disputes.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quote: In marriage, a man becomes slack and selfish, and undergoes a fatty degeneration of his moral being.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quote: For it is mutual trust, even more than mutual interest that holds human associations together. Our friends seldom profit us but they make us feel safe. Marriage is a scheme to accomplish exactly that same end.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: Like me, the great majority of Americans wish both to preserve the traditional definition of marriage and to oppose bias and intolerance directed towards gays and lesbians.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: If you cannot work on the marriage or the women is a moron, staying married and cheating makes the most sense because divorce is disruptive to the family life and your bank account.
author: Al Goldstein

quote: And let me make this very clear - unlike President Obama, I will not raise taxes on the middle class. As president, I will protect the sanctity of life. I will honor the institution of marriage. And I will guarantee America's first liberty: the freedom of religion.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: In every marriage more than a week old, there are grounds for divorce. The trick is to find, and continue to find, grounds for marriage.
author: Robert Anderson

quote: Culture, what you believe, what you value, how you live matters. Now, as fundamental as these principles are, they may become topics of democratic debates from time to time, so it is today with the enduring institution of marriage. Marriage is a relationship between a man and a woman.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: I've yet to be on a campus where most women weren't worrying about some aspect of combining marriage, children, and a career. I've yet to find one where many men were worrying about the same thing.
author: Gloria Steinem

quote: I think what makes our marriage work amid all the glare is that my husband is my best friend. He inspires everything in my life and enables me to do the best that I can. I want to hang out with him more than anyone.

quote: The secret of a happy marriage is finding the right person. You know they're right if you love to be with them all the time.
author: Julia Child

quote: Little children are still the symbol of the eternal marriage between love and duty.
author: George Eliot

quote: We sleep in separate rooms, we have dinner apart, we take separate vacations - we're doing everything we can to keep our marriage together.
author: Rodney Dangerfield

quote: In almost every marriage there is a selfish and an unselfish partner. A pattern is set up and soon becomes inflexible, of one person always making the demands and one person always giving way.

quote: My marriage is on the rocks again, yeah, my wife just broke up with her boyfriend.
author: Rodney Dangerfield

quote: Marriage is the death of hope.
author: Woody Allen

quote: Some people ask the secret of our long marriage. We take time to go to a restaurant two times a week. A little candlelight, dinner, soft music and dancing. She goes Tuesdays, I go Fridays.
author: Henny Youngman

quote: Anyone who thinks that the vice-president can take a position independent of the president of his administration simply has no knowledge of politics or government. You are his choice in a political marriage, and he expects your absolute loyalty.
author: Hubert H. Humphrey

quote: I believe the home and marriage is the foundation of our society and must be protected.
author: Billy Graham

quote: Marriage is a very good thing, but I think it's a mistake to make a habit out of it.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: I respect the fact that many denominations have different points of view with respect to gay marriage and they can hold that in the sanctity in the place of their religion and not bless them or solemnize them.
author: Colin Powell

quote: Marriage is a great institution.
author: Elizabeth Taylor

quote: Marriage brings one into fatal connection with custom and tradition, and traditions and customs are like the wind and weather, altogether incalculable.
author: Soren Kierkegaard

quote: Even in the common affairs of life, in love, friendship, and marriage, how little security have we when we trust our happiness in the hands of others!
author: William Hazlitt

quote: A woman asking 'Am I good? Am I satisfied?' is extremely selfish. The less women fuss about themselves, the less they talk to other women, the more they try to please their husbands, the happier the marriage is going to be.
author: Barbara Cartland

quote: Staying married may have long-term benefits. You can elicit much more sympathy from friends over a bad marriage than you ever can from a good divorce.
author: P. J. O'Rourke

quote: Brought up to respect the conventions, love had to end in marriage. I'm afraid it did.
author: Bette Davis

quote: Romantic love is an illusion. Most of us discover this truth at the end of a love affair or else when the sweet emotions of love lead us into marriage and then turn down their flames.
author: Thomas Moore

quote: Even though people may be well known, they hold in their hearts the emotions of a simple person for the moments that are the most important of those we know on earth: birth, marriage and death.
author: Jackie Kennedy

quote: One should believe in marriage as in the immortality of the soul.

quote: I have a wonderful marriage and two great kids.

author: Keith O'Brien

quote: I have no useful theories about love and marriage.

quote: Marriage, if one will face the truth, is an evil, but a necessary evil.
author: Menander

author: Ted Olson

quote: There's something about marriage that is not as intensely romantic or interesting as a couple's first meeting.

quote: Marriage and the creation of families has been an integral part of our society since its creation it should not be defined without the kind of involvement by the people which a constitutional process would require.

quote: Marriage, even the best marriages are tough.

quote: I guess you kind of got to realize that once you in a marriage, whatever it is, you gotta deal with it. Not necessarily that you got to accept it, but you have to deal with it and try your best to make it work for you, for the both of you.

quote: Everything in life is a lesson and I have learned from each marriage. Yes, I've made mistakes but every experience is a learning curve.

quote: I left my marriage knowing I'd have to work. I have.

quote: Marriage: love, honor, and negotiate.

quote: Other than marriage, she doesn't control me and I don't control her.

quote: My wife disagrees with 100 percent of what I say. That's the same marriage I have.

quote: If you want to sacrifice the admiration of many men for the criticism of one, go ahead, get married.

quote: If you want to give up the admiration of thousands of men for the distain of one, go ahead, get married.

quote: The only really happy folk are married women and single men.

quote: Men have a much better time of it than women. For one thing, they marry later for another thing, they die earlier.

quote: I'm done with men... I'm going to be alone. I have no luck with relationships. I don't think I'm made for marriage.

quote: What is the price of experience? Do men buy it for a song? Or wisdom for a dance in the street? No, it is bought with the price of all the man hath, his house, his wife, his children.

quote: I have known more men destroyed by the desire to have wife and child and to keep them in comfort than I have seen destroyed by drink and harlots.

quote: Married men live longer than single men. But married men are a lot more willing to die.

quote: I know many married men, I even know a few happily married men, but I don't know one who wouldn't fall down the first open coal hole running after the first pretty girl who gave him a wink.

quote: Strong women only marry weak men.

quote: It's the moms of this nation - single, married, widowed - who really hold this country together. quote: A woman must combine the role of mother, wife and politician.

quote: The man in our society is the breadwinner the woman has enough to do as the homemaker, wife and mother.

quote: The woman is uniformly sacrificed to the wife and mother.

quote: People think I have courage. The courage in my family are my wife Pam, my three daughters, here, Nicole, Jamie, LeeAnn, my mom, who's right here too.

quote: My mom's never been married. I've never even seen my mom kiss a dude.

quote: It's been very hard, after being mostly a mom, to develop an adult life of my own. And not being married anymore, I have to come up with challenges.

quote: OK, so my parents were married in 1955 and my mom knew my dad was gay and my dad knew he was gay and so I was, like, 'Why in the heck did you get married?' Like, what was going on? quote: My mom and my dad were married 56 years, and the fact that I reconciled with my dad I think made their marriage a little bit better as well.

quote: I prefer to imagine that my wife, a few friends, and occasionally my mom are the only ones who read what I do, though I realize that this is somewhat unrealistic.

quote: My mom's been married three times my dad has been married a lot. I didn't really see my dad that much.
author: Skeet Ulrich

quote: I want to make my music and be a happy woman, a good wife, a good mom and one day hopefully have a child of my own.
author: LeAnn Rimes

quote: The fact that I'm very close with my past relationships is something I pride myself on. My mom is still close to her first husband. It's nice to be able to enjoy someone in a different form.
author: Kate Bosworth

quote: I am excited to rise today to support National Mom and Pop Business Owners Day. This celebration honors the husband and wife business owner teams whose work helps drive the economy and fuel job growth.
author: Melissa Bean

quote: I'm a nice, happily married wife and mom and I live in Connecticut.
author: Christine Baranski

quote: My daily schedule is quite hectic, but I have to put my health first in order to be the best mom and wife I can be.
author: Ellen Pompeo

quote: But to sustain a marriage for 50 years, you have to get real a little bit and find someone who is understanding and who you can grow with. My mom always says, 'Marry the man who loves you a millimeter more.'
author: Ali Larter

quote: I wanted to marry a girl just like my mom.
author: Michael Bergin

quote: I played with dolls until I was 15. My mother encouraged it because my older sister got married when she was 15, so Mom thought that the longer I stayed with dolls, the better.
author: Linda Evans

quote: Married and divorced, three beautiful daughters, two in college. The other one is 16, lives with her mom. I'm 46, I've worked for the Post Office for 18 years, seven facilities in three states.
author: Arthur Godfrey

quote: But my mother and father were married when my mom was 20 and my dad was 24.
author: Rachael Leigh Cook

quote: They see me as being this Super Mom on TV who also can more than handle a difficult husband, and they assume I'm going to be just full of wisdom as a mother and wife myself.
author: Patricia Richardson

quote: I always think about which blood drive was going on in Georgia that day when that husband or mom or school teacher rolled up their sleeve and actually gave me a second chance at life. It's the ultimate gift of life, and I'm the one who was on the other end.
author: Niki Taylor

quote: My mom, Emilie, always taught me to think hard about marriage.
author: Alyson Hannigan

quote: I'm looking forward to being a mom and a wife and a business owner.
author: Melanie Roach

quote: A successful man is one who makes more money than his wife can spend. A successful woman is one who can find such a man.
author: Lana Turner

quote: There are three faithful friends - an old wife, an old dog, and ready money.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: The first time you marry for love, the second for money, and the third for companionship.
author: Jackie Kennedy

quote: In marriage do thou be wise: prefer the person before money, virtue before beauty, the mind before the body then thou hast a wife, a friend, a companion, a second self.
author: William Penn

quote: I've had an exciting time I married for love and got a little money along with it.
author: Rose Kennedy

quote: I still think of that guy I was without a wife or kids, and I still want to entertain that guy. The lonely guy, the frustrated guy, the guy with no money - this is the guy who needs to laugh.
author: Larry David

quote: They say Yogi Berra is funny. Well, he has a lovely wife and family, a beautiful home, money in the bank, and he plays golf with millionaires. What's funny about that?
author: Casey Stengel

quote: They got married, they got divorced, and half their money goes out the window.
author: Suze Orman

quote: People don't have fortunes left them in that style nowadays men have to work and women to marry for money. It's a dreadfully unjust world.
author: Louisa May Alcott

quote: The only thing I like more than my wife is my money, and I'm not about to lose that to her and her lawyers, that's for damn sure.
author: Jon Bon Jovi

quote: Marriage, like money, is still with us and, like money, progressively devalued.
author: Robert Graves

quote: Never ever discount the idea of marriage. Sure, someone might tell you that marriage is just a piece of paper. Well, so is money, and what's more life-affirming than cold, hard cash?
author: Dennis Miller

quote: The problem with marriage is that it ends every night after making love, and it must be rebuilt every morning before breakfast.
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

quote: A good wife is one who serves her husband in the morning like a mother does, loves him in the day like a sister does and pleases him like a prostitute in the night.
author: Chanakya

quote: A good husband is never the first to go to sleep at night or the last to awake in the morning.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: To be intimate with a married man, when my own father cheated on my mother, is not something I could forgive. I could not look at myself in the morning if I did that. I wouldn't be attracted to a man who would cheat on his wife.
author: Angelina Jolie

quote: Mom and Dad were married 64 years. And if you wondered what their secret was, you could have asked the local florist - because every day Dad gave Mom a rose, which he put on her bedside table. That's how she found out what happened on the day my father died - she went looking for him because that morning, there was no rose.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: There's pros and cons of a big church. Cons is I don't get to know everybody, I don't get to go to their ballgame, I don't get to marry everybody, but the pros are you get all this community, 800 ushers come in to serve, getting there at 7 in the morning on their day off and coming in on Saturday to make all those wafers.
author: Joel Osteen

quote: I never married because there was no need. I have three pets at home which answer the same purpose as a husband. I have a dog which growls every morning, a parrot which swears all afternoon, and a cat that comes home late at night.
author: Marie Corelli

quote: I'm going to marry a Jewish woman because I like the idea of getting up Sunday morning and going to the deli.
author: Michael J. Fox

quote: I wake up at 5:30, 6 in the morning, but don't head into the office right away. I like to hang out with my wife, talk about things, get some coffee, you know.
author: Ice Cube

quote: Early in the morning, I fell in love with the girl that later on became my wife. At that time, we were so naive. I wanted to charm her, so I read her Capital by Marx. I thought somehow she would be convinced by the strength of his criticism about capital.
author: Shimon Peres

quote: I am a fashion designer. I'm not an environmentalist. When I get up in the morning, number one I'm a mother and a wife, and number two I design clothes. So the main thing I need to do is create, hopefully, exquisitely beautiful, desirable objects for my customer.
author: Stella McCartney

quote: I never laugh or smile when I am writing. When I come home for lunch after writing all morning, my wife says I look like I just came home from a funeral. This is not bragging. This is an illness.
author: Carl Hiaasen

quote: My wife gets all the money I make. I just get an apple and clean clothes every morning.
author: Ray Romano

quote: She got the magazine on a Wednesday morning, and on Thursday announced our marriage was over.
author: David Gest

quote: When a man has been consistently battering his wife, he shouldn't expect a bouquet of roses from her the morning after he promises to stop.
author: Joe Slovo

quote: I had an amazing childhood, lots of love. But my dad worked his tail off, getting up at 4 in the morning and going off at 5, 6 o'clock, yet he always had time to spend with his kids and his wife.
author: Criss Angel

quote: Never get married in the morning - you never know who you might meet that night.
author: Paul Hornung

quote: In the last year my wife has noticed me struggling to get downstairs on a Sunday morning. I've two young children and football has been so good to me over the years I don't want to spoil it.
author: Graeme Le Saux

quote: When I read the pilot 'for Married with Children', it just reminded me of my Uncle Joe... just a self-deprecating kind of guy. He'd come home from work, and the wife would maybe say 'I ran over the dog this morning in the driveway'. And he would say 'Fine, what's for dinner?
author: Ed O'Neill

quote: I write in the morning from about eight till noon, and sometimes again a bit in the afternoon. In the morning I start off by going over what I had done the previous day, which my wife has happily typed up for me.
author: Gene Hackman

quote: My wife gets pampered pretty well. She's had me trained since she was pregnant, when I started making her oatmeal with fresh berries every morning.
author: Michael Weatherly

quote: I get up at sunrise. I'm a Buddhist, so I chant in the morning. My wife and I sit and have coffee together, but then it's list-making time. I have carpentry projects. We have roads we keep in repair. It's not back-breaking, but it's certainly aerobic and mildly strenuous.
author: Patrick Duffy

quote: My wife and I just prefer Seattle. It's a beautiful city. Great setting. You open your front door in the morning and the air smells like pine and the sea, as opposed to bus exhaust.
author: Ron Reagan

quote: I just had that conversation this morning with my doctor. I just got back from the hospital a half-hour ago, and nothing will make me happier than to replicate the DNA of my amazing husband. I'm optimistic.
author: Karen Duffy

quote: When Andrew went with the girls, we were talking all morning and he was saying, 'It's okay. Just remember we had such a good day. Our wedding was so perfect.' Because we're such a unit together. He made me feel very part of the day on April the 29th.
author: Sarah Ferguson

quote: Always get married in the morning. That way if it doesn't work out, you haven't wasted the whole day.
author: Mickey Rooney

quote: I'm married to the theater but my mistress is the films.
author: Oskar Werner

quote: My wife comes with me on all the movies, but she is not an appendage to a film star or anything like that. She is a completely intertwined partner. She is the other half of me. Also, we're still very much in love with each other. We always have been, we always will be.
author: Michael Caine

quote: It seems to me that one thing people do over and over again is try to figure out how to get married, stay married, fall in love, how to rekindle all this stuff. It seems to me to be a pretty eternal theme so I don't know if you can get typecast from making movies about men relating to women. It seems to be what is going on on the planet a lot.
author: John Cusack

quote: It's just as hard... staying happily married as it is doing movies.
author: Tom Hanks

quote: My mom was a professional. My dad and mom met each other in a movie called 'New Faces of 1937.' My mom went under the name Thelma Leeds, and she did a few movies, and she was really a great singer, and when she married my dad and started to have a family, she sang at parties.
author: Albert Brooks

quote: It's time for me to do things I like so I will be happy, my wife will be happy, my friends will be happy. I just want to do something I'm proud of. It's time for me to change. I could sign with a company for 10 movies and I'm the king of video and so what?
author: Jean Claude Van Damme

quote: I kind of came to the conclusion after I did finally get married that love and relationships are just a series of horrific losses with hopefully one win.
author: Justin Halpern

quote: As far as friendships go, things change even without the fame. People start moving on. I have a few friends that are married and are starting to have kids and I'm like, 'Oh my goodness gracious - that's so insane.' I also have friends who are just doing their own thing, which is cool.
author: Jordin Sparks

quote: Some people ask the secret of our long marriage. We take time to go to a restaurant two times a week. A little candlelight, dinner, soft music and dancing. She goes Tuesdays, I go Fridays.
author: Henny Youngman

quote: I've always been suspicious of TV, I've always found music and video to be an unhappy marriage.
author: Keith Richards

quote: I met Prince William at a musical festival and he let me know he was a fan of my music. But the invitation to sing at his wedding reception came completely out of the blue. The fact that Kate and William knew the words to my songs was very touching.
author: Ellie Goulding

quote: My husband is a composer, so he plays piano all the time and I sit there and clap telling my unborn child, 'Hear me clap, hear the music.' I know music, in general, is supposed to be good for babies to hear.
author: Danica McKellar

quote: I always wanted my music to influence the life you were living emotionally - with your family, your lover, your wife, and, at a certain point, with your children.
author: Bruce Springsteen

quote: Marriage is nature's way of keeping us from fighting with strangers.
author: Alan King

quote: Married love between man and woman is bigger than oaths guarded by right of nature.
author: Aeschylus

quote: When I'm off the road, my husband and I recharge our batteries. It's a day of deep rest and connection with the spiritual, and that can be anything - going for a walk in nature, being in silence, burning incense.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: Marriage is an institution fits in perfect harmony with the laws of nature whereas systems of slavery and segregation were designed to brutally oppress people and thereby violated the laws of nature.
author: Jack Kingston

quote: When a man and a woman have an overwhelming passion for each other, it seems to me, in spite of such obstacles dividing them as parents or husband, that they belong to each other in the name of Nature, and are lovers by Divine right, in spite of human convention or the laws.
author: Nicolas Chamfort

quote: Children that are raised in a home with a married mother and father consistently do better in every measure of well-being than their peers who come from divorced or step-parent, single-parent, cohabiting homes.
author: Todd Tiahrt

quote: Do you want to be an artist and a writer, or a wife and a lover? With kids, your focus changes. I don't want to go to PTA meetings.
author: Stevie Nicks

quote: Mama and Daddy King represent the best in manhood and womanhood, the best in a marriage, the kind of people we are trying to become.
author: Coretta Scott King

quote: I realize that of all people, I am no expert on parenting or marriage.
author: Mika Brzezinski

quote: In response to our fast-food culture, a 'slow food' movement appeared. Out of hurried parenthood, a move toward slow parenting could be growing. With vital government supports for state-of-the-art public child care and paid parental leave, maybe we would be ready to try slow love and marriage.
author: Arlie Russell Hochschild

quote: No, you're not allowed to be bossy when you're married. You have to learn compromise, and compassion and patience.
author: Star Jones

quote: There's not a lot of room anymore for what I call 'made-up' drama. The drama comes from real places now - marriage takes work and focus, the kid stuff takes patience and commitment. And if you don't grow as people and as a couple, within all of that, then you've got some real drama.
author: Jeremy Sisto

quote: My wife is the most awesome person in the universe. She's made this experience much less miserable for me, with her compassion, patience and understanding.
author: Wil Wheaton

quote: The game is my wife. It demands loyalty and responsibility, and it gives me back fulfillment and peace.
author: Michael Jordan

quote: We call that person who has lost his father, an orphan and a widower that man who has lost his wife. But that man who has known the immense unhappiness of losing a friend, by what name do we call him? Here every language is silent and holds its peace in impotence.
author: Joseph Roux

quote: My decision to end my marriage was such a risk to lose ratings and lose my fan base. I had to take that risk for my inner peace and to be happy with myself.
author: Kim Kardashian

quote: The only solid and lasting peace between a man and his wife is, doubtless, a separation.
author: Lord Chesterfield

quote: I'm married. My wife, Stella - a beautiful woman. She's brought a lot of peace to my life, a lot of wisdom.
author: Anthony Hopkins

quote: If there's no inner peace, people can't give it to you. The husband can't give it to you. Your children can't give it to you. You have to give it to you.
author: Linda Evans

quote: I created the Women's Federation for World Peace in order to restore all that woman originally lost. You American women don't need a man in the position of grandfather, parents, husband, elder or younger brother. You only need the true Adam.
author: Sun Myung Moon

quote: Whether it be a matter of personal relations within a marriage or political initiatives within a peace process, there is no sure-fire do-it-yourself kit.
author: Seamus Heaney

quote: I never married because there was no need. I have three pets at home which answer the same purpose as a husband. I have a dog which growls every morning, a parrot which swears all afternoon, and a cat that comes home late at night.
author: Marie Corelli

quote: There's just me and my wife and a dog and we feed him Healthy Choice also.
author: Mike Ditka

quote: Marriage - a book of which the first chapter is written in poetry and the remaining chapters in prose.
author: Beverley Nichols

quote: This is a good time to ask apologists for the Islamic regime, who degrades Islam? Who imposes stoning, forced marriage of underage girls and flogging for not wearing the veil? Do such practices represent Iran's ancient history and culture, its ethnic and religious diversity? Its centuries of sensual and subversive poetry?
author: Azar Nafisi

quote: I wonder if I ever thought of an ideal reader... I guess when I was in my 20s and in New York and maybe even in my early 30s, I would write for my wife Janice... mainly for my poet friends and my wife, who was very smart about poetry.
author: Kenneth Koch

quote: I did know Ted Hughes and I partly wrote the book to explain to myself and others the complexities of a marriage that was for six years wonderfully productive of poetry and then ended in tragedy.
author: Anne Stevenson

quote: One of the things I've always liked about my husband is he's very good at lots of stuff. He was an English teacher when I met him. He wrote poetry and played the guitar. As time went on, he decided to go into economics, so he's very analytical and mathematical in addition to his artsy side.
author: Ally Condie

quote: Politics doesn't make strange bedfellows - marriage does.
author: Groucho Marx

quote: Anyone who thinks that the vice-president can take a position independent of the president of his administration simply has no knowledge of politics or government. You are his choice in a political marriage, and he expects your absolute loyalty.
author: Hubert H. Humphrey

quote: What is a wife and what is a harlot? What is a church and what is a theatre? are they two and not one? Can they exist separate? Are not religion and politics the same thing? Brotherhood is religion. O demonstrations of reason dividing families in cruelty and pride!
author: William Blake

quote: Well there's nobody who has a more supportive husband than I do, and he has a business that he runs, and it's his own business, so he has work to do, my kids have school to do, I mean, people have - there are other things in life besides politics.
author: Caroline Kennedy

quote: Men enter local politics solely as a result of being unhappily married.
author: C. Northcote Parkinson

quote: I met my wife Anne who was a sociology student, and her influence together with activities associated with the student movement of the time opened up my interests amongst other things into the theatre, art, music, politics and philosophy.
author: Paul Nurse

quote: I know my limitations, and I don't like politics. I was only involved because of my husband.
author: Corazon Aquino

quote: I mean, the part you don't like, I mean, that's the only part. That's the part no one likes, and that is the criticisms, and the unfair criticisms, I might add, of my husband. But that's also just a fact of life in politics.
author: Laura Bush

quote: And that is why marriage and family law has emphasized the importance of marriage as the foundation of family, addressing the needs of children in the most positive way.
author: John Boehner

quote: My wife was the first romantic partner who understood both American and native parts of me - not so much the positive stuff, but the damage.
author: Sherman Alexie

quote: A true king is neither husband nor father he considers his throne and nothing else.
author: Pierre Corneille

quote: Beauty, n: the power by which a woman charms a lover and terrifies a husband.
author: Ambrose Bierce

quote: I love being a wife and homemaker - because it's my choice. My husband doesn't expect me to do it. I don't mind doing things for him because he does so much for me we both feel that way so there is no power struggle.
author: Salma Hayek

quote: I have hair that I audition with, my sitcom hair which is a curly wig. I have my long chic hair that I wear to my son's school so they know I'm not playing around. I always tell people that my husband gets a different woman every night when I come home from 'The View.' Hair makes you feel a certain way, like putting a power suit on.
author: Sherri Shepherd

quote: So many people prefer to live in drama because it's comfortable. It's like someone staying in a bad marriage or relationship - it's actually easier to stay because they know what to expect every day, versus leaving and not knowing what to expect.
author: Ellen DeGeneres

quote: The relationship between husband and wife should be one of closest friends.
author: B. R. Ambedkar

quote: My view is that marriage is a relationship between a man and a woman. That's the position I've had for some time, and I don't intend to make any adjustments at this point... Or ever, by the way.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: I'm done with men... I'm going to be alone. I have no luck with relationships. I don't think I'm made for marriage.
author: Halle Berry

quote: You are not alone with a guy until you are a proper age. You don't go to certain levels with men until you are married or you have a certain relationship.
author: Daisy Fuentes

quote: Every good relationship, especially marriage, is based on respect. If it's not based on respect, nothing that appears to be good will last very long.
author: Amy Grant

quote: There is no more lovely, friendly and charming relationship, communion or company than a good marriage.
author: Martin Luther

quote: When you make the sacrifice in marriage, you're sacrificing not to each other but to unity in a relationship.
author: Joseph Campbell

quote: Marriage destroyed my relationship with two wonderful men.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: Culture, what you believe, what you value, how you live matters. Now, as fundamental as these principles are, they may become topics of democratic debates from time to time, so it is today with the enduring institution of marriage. Marriage is a relationship between a man and a woman.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: I'm so wrapped up in my work that it's often impossible to consider other things in my life. My marriage ended in divorce because of this, my relationship with Holly has suffered by this.
author: Jim Carrey

quote: It's important to take time for your spouse and nurture the relationship.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: Political promises are much like marriage vows. They are made at the beginning of the relationship between candidate and voter, but are quickly forgotten.
author: Dick Gregory

quote: When I'm working, I'm very purposeful and everything else gets out of focus. Something I've had to work on together with my wife is how to acknowledge each other in the midst of this and keep the relationship going.
author: Jeff Bridges

quote: The mark of a good marriage is partnership and continuing to feel inspired by your spouse. I had that with Tao. But the end is not necessarily the tragedy. Staying in a relationship that is no longer working is the tragedy. Living unhappily - that's the tragedy.
author: Olivia Wilde

quote: Although we were never pals and occasionally butted heads, my relationship with Clinton and his wife, Hillary, made me a better journalist.
author: Ron Fournier

quote: Unfenced by law, the unmarried lover can quit a bad relationship at any time. But you - the legally married person who wants to escape doomed love - may soon discover that a significant portion of your marriage contract belongs to the State, and that it sometimes takes a very long while for the State to grant you your leave.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quote: There was a time in the marriage when I could no longer look at myself in a mirror, couldn't feel I was a nice person. A bad relationship can do that, can make you doubt everything good you ever felt about yourself.
author: Dionne Warwick

quote: Marriage is a very sacred institution and should not be degraded by allowing every other type of relationship to be made equivalent to it.
author: Benjamin Carson

quote: There was no relationship between a wedding dress and fashion. There was no good taste, either. I realized that I could make an impression in terms of changing and readdressing the whole industry of bridal.
author: Vera Wang

quote: Most people like to read about intrigue and spies. I hope to provide a metaphor for the average reader's daily life. Most of us live in a slightly conspiratorial relationship with our employer and perhaps with our marriage.
author: John le Carre

quote: Now I'm a wife and a mother of two. It's a really different role. I always referred to No Doubt as a marriage, because that's what it's like to be together for so long and go through what we've been through. I can't really have that relationship with them anymore.
author: Gwen Stefani

quote: If you love somebody, you love them. My parents had a 25-year age gap between them and my mum was the breadwinner, my dad the house husband. I'm a strong believer that a good relationship can work, whatever the situation.
author: Katherine Jenkins

quote: We run into some pretty tough arguments sometimes, but the idea is that at the end of the day, my wife and I realize that we'll always be holding each other's hand. This is a lifelong relationship, and after 12 years she hasn't gotten rid of me yet.
author: Kyle Chandler

quote: My grandparents got married at a very young age, and a lot of what I think about marriage is based on their relationship. I watched them over the years and saw how they dealt with everything together, as a team.
author: Kyle Chandler

quote: My grandparents got married at a very young age, and a lot of what I think about marriage is based on their relationship.
author: Kyle Chandler

quote: In December 1998, I considered myself an expert on love. I was almost a year into a relationship, one that had grown more slowly than I had wished, but once it flowered it was much more stimulating than any marriage or relationship I had known.
author: Jane Smiley

quote: A lot of Hollywood couples get married young and wind up growing out of their relationship.
author: Patti Stanger

quote: A lot of married people certainly have wonderful relationships with their dogs, but when you're single and your dog is the only other living thing in your house, it's a really special relationship which I wanted CATHY to have.
author: Cathy Guisewite

quote: In marriage, compromise nurtures the relationship.
author: Tim Allen

quote: I believe wholeheartedly in marriage. I don't exclusively mean a marriage with a legal contract, but any relationship that constitutes a marriage because of the quality of their relationship.
author: Helen Reddy

quote: I've stepped more into my womanhood, I'm a mother now, I'm having a beautiful relationship as a wife and as a friend.
author: Alicia Keys

quote: Yes, I was in love with my husband at first sight and still am. We have the most solid relationship.
author: Catherine Zeta-Jones

quote: I'd think,'In a relationship, we should never have his kind of fight.' Then, instead of figuring out how to make it work, I looked for a way to get out of it. The truth is, you shouldn't be married if your that kind of person.
author: George Clooney

quote: I married him for a green card. We had a really great, caring relationship it just obviously wasn't right for me.
author: Portia de Rossi

quote: I don't know what my version of a relationship or marriage is yet, because the typical model seems a little broken to me.
author: Michelle Williams

quote: Success is hard in general for most women. We now have such busy lives, and we're told we can do everything - you know, we can have the relationship and the marriage and the kids and the career.
author: Cat Deeley

quote: My personal belief is that you carry your own water in a relationship. If you see a girl and you think she's hot, that's a very human reaction, but you don't go and tell your spouse that, you know? So in one way it's how you behave.
author: Mark Ruffalo

quote: If I get married, it's something you really have to work at. It's hard enough to work at having a relationship with best friends and girls that are in the business.
author: Selma Blair

quote: I've got five kids and I'm married, Tommy's got two kids and he's been married, Vince just got married again, Mick's out of a relationship, Tommy's single as well. We've done a lot in our life, we've covered a lot of miles.
author: Nikki Sixx

quote: My wife, Jill, and I have an incredibly close working relationship, and an incredibly happy married one. We met through work. I was the world's worst advertising copywriter. She had the misfortune to be my account director, so from the very start she was my boss, and she still is.
author: Anthony Horowitz

quote: As part of my relationship with my wife and my daughter, and we share everything and talk about everything.
author: Boris Kodjoe

quote: If someone talks about union, fidelity, a monogamous relationship, love, blessing I would say it sounds like marriage to me. And blessing, you see, I think is undermining our sacrament of marriage.
author: George Carey

quote: My parents had a great marriage. Interestingly, it made it harder for me in relationships because I knew what a good relationship looked like.
author: Candace Bushnell

quote: I believe I went through a divorce. My relationship with Ellen is no less significant as a marriage than my relationship to Coley.
author: Anne Heche

quote: I really take pride in the relationship that I have with my husband.
author: Julie Benz

quote: My relationship with Dean was great, but ultimately it wasn't a fulfilling marriage for either of us.
author: LeAnn Rimes

quote: I had a career and I came to motherhood late and am not married and have never had such a trusting relationship with a man - and trust is where the real power of love comes from.
author: Diane Keaton

quote: I honestly believe you can never tell if a relationship is going to last. In my own marriage, which is going on 14 years, I don't think of it as 'I'm going to be with this person forever.' Instead, I think of more like, 'I'll probably be with this person for the next six weeks. Then I'll re-evaluate.'
author: Michael Ian Black

quote: People here in Los Angeles are disgusted now about a sex scandal involving Arnold Schwarzenegger. Apparently for seven years, he carried on a sexual relationship with his own wife.
author: Craig Kilborn

quote: I have an amazing relationship with my wife, but sometimes there are arguments. It happens.
author: Kris Allen

quote: When Luke and Laura dated in 'General Hospital' when I was a kid, I was very excited. And that was a rather pathetic relationship if you break it down because let's face it: he raped her... and then they got married. There's all kinds of things that TV does to relationships.
author: Lisa Edelstein

quote: A lot of people seem to want to make the institution of marriage substitute for a real relationship.
author: Susan Faludi

quote: My husband. He keeps me grounded. If I were in the world on my own, it would all be much more seductive. But I'm in a relationship that has nothing to do with the film world.
author: Emily Watson

quote: You can't have a relationship when you're shooting a 14-hour day and your husband is shooting a 14-hour day in the same city. It's a time thing and it's a together thing.
author: Eva Longoria

quote: I took the fear of marriage from my parents' relationship, because I didn't want to end up in a relationship like that, whereas my brothers and sisters learnt a lesson from it and made sure they didn't carry it on into their own marriages.
author: John Mahoney

quote: If you have parents with a healthy relationship, you don't learn that you don't have to be married. I thought being a healthy adult meant you had to have a spouse. I didn't know any different.
author: Alyssa Milano

quote: It was not a healthy marriage for long time. It was never about another man, it was about what my and Dennis's relationship could not sustain.
author: Meg Ryan

quote: My parents had a wonderful marriage, but it was a very dependent relationship. My mother was entirely dependent on my father because that's how it was in those days.
author: Erika Slezak

quote: We had a relationship that lasted 44 years. Herbert and I lived together 10 years before we were married. He always gave me a little heart for whatever anniversary.
author: Uta Hagen

quote: I've had four amazing men in my life, very strong, powerful, wonderful men. I certainly will have a relationship with someone but I don't think I will get married again.
author: Cheryl Tiegs

quote: I love being in a relationship, but marriage isn't for me.
author: Arsenio Hall

quote: It's very different than it use to be. I think everybody has a lot more experience in how to be in a relationship - whether it's a marriage or a significant other or a business or a friend.
author: Kathy Valentine

quote: I think the most important foundation about any relationship is just being honest. You've got to. My wife and I are honest to a fault with each other, and we're best friends on top of it, so we're very fortunate.
author: Max Greenfield

quote: I was glad to hear of that determination as I detest the practice of cousins marrying or any marriage between persons in which there can be traced the most distant relationship. I go for the improvement instead of the deterioration of our race.
author: Ezra Cornell
