quote: There were many women around. We all had a relationship with each other that was very strong. And all of our minds kind of hooked up. We rejected the society. We rejected marriage because we didn't like what our parents had.
author: Lynette Fromme

quote: Every good relationship, especially marriage, is based on respect. If it's not based on respect, nothing that appears to be good will last very long.
author: Amy Grant

quote: We must respect the other fellow's religion, but only in the sense and to the extent that we respect his theory that his wife is beautiful and his children smart.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: I have noticed... that men usually leave married women alone and are inclined to treat all wives with respect. This is no great credit to married women.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: I feel very deeply about the need to respect and tolerate people of different social - or sexual orientation. But at the same time, I believe marriage should be preserved as an institution for one man and one woman.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: With my wife I don't get no respect. I made a toast on her birthday to 'the best woman a man ever had.' The waiter joined me.
author: Rodney Dangerfield

quote: I respect the fact that many denominations have different points of view with respect to gay marriage and they can hold that in the sanctity in the place of their religion and not bless them or solemnize them.
author: Colin Powell

quote: Brought up to respect the conventions, love had to end in marriage. I'm afraid it did.
author: Bette Davis

quote: I respect a woman too much to marry her.
author: Sylvester Stallone

quote: We must have great respect for these people who also suffer and who want to find their own way of correct living. On the other hand, to create a legal form of a kind of homosexual marriage, in reality, does not help these people.
author: Joseph Ratzinger

quote: I think of marriage as a garden. You have to tend to it. Respect it, take care of it, feed it. Make sure everyone is getting the right amount of, um, sunlight.
author: Mark Ruffalo

quote: We must have great respect for these people who also suffer and who want to find their own way of correct living. On the other hand, to create a legal form of a kind of homosexual marriage, in reality, does not help these people.
author: Pope Benedict XVI

quote: Like I said, I've got too much respect for women to marry them, but that doesn't mean you can't support them emotionally and financially.
author: Sylvester Stallone

quote: I don't think there's anything they can say about me that I haven't said about myself already. And I would be an absolute total liar, and my fans would not respect me, if I said that my life and my marriage are perfect. But we absolutely love each other we have fun together - it's great.
author: Mary J. Blige

quote: You can be cool and at the same time respect your woman, who will hopefully become your wife, who will hopefully become the mother of your kids. America needs to get back to family values.
author: Martin Lawrence

quote: I have a lot of respect for marriage.
author: Dominic Monaghan

quote: How can a Man respect his Wife when he has a contemptible Opinion of her and her Sex?
author: Mary Astell

quote: Above all, we must have great respect for these people who also suffer and who want to find their own way of correct living. On the other hand, to create a legal form of a kind of homosexual marriage, in reality, does not help these people.
author: Joseph Ratzinger

quote: I've never met a person who has more integrity than my husband. I respect that. There's his humor and intelligence, too, and he's really cute, all those things - but if you don't respect your partner, you'll get sick of him.
author: Michelle Pfeiffer

quote: The Obama administration now has regulations that tells them that they can no longer promote marriage to these young girls. They can no longer promote marriage as a way of avoiding poverty and bad choices that they make in their life. They can no longer even teach abstinence education. They have to be neutral with respect to how people behave.
author: Rick Santorum

quote: Marriage gives you a new respect for a person.
author: Katharine McPhee

quote: I try to be the best husband I can be, and if people respect that, that's cool. But there's no 'perfect husband.' We just all try to do the best we can, you know what I mean?
author: Nick Lachey

quote: I always used to say to my wife, the thing that I loved most about us is that we are a team, we are impenetrable in that respect.
author: Seal

quote: I was raised Jewish, my wife was raised Catholic. Though we respect each other's heritage, and while many of our friends are deeply religious, we have chosen to focus on our similarities, not our differences. We teach our children compassion, charity, honesty and the benefits of hard work.
author: Steven Levitan

quote: Next month, I will celebrate my 30th anniversary of marriage with my beautiful bride, Vicki. Our marriage has been a blessing. I have gained even more respect for the institution over the past 3 decades and will defend it against attack.
author: Todd Tiahrt

quote: As an actor, you just want to work, and then you just want to be on a show or have a job that you love, and you hope that job will last - those things have happened. To have that platform to then talk about something that is very personal to me like marriage equality, it feels like a gift. I try and really respect that voice and not abuse it.
author: Jesse Tyler Ferguson

quote: You don't stay married for thirty-nine years because of sex or even because of love, but because your partner is a real friend to you, because they respect and regard you.
author: Olympia Dukakis

quote: We are talking about someone who has lived. It must be honored in every respect. The fictional can take any kind of channel - according to the actor's marriage to the character.
author: Kate Mulgrew

quote: Romantic love is an illusion. Most of us discover this truth at the end of a love affair or else when the sweet emotions of love lead us into marriage and then turn down their flames.
author: Thomas Moore

quote: I'm very romantic, I'm extremely romantic. I date my wife.
author: Alice Cooper

quote: I have to be asked, I guess, but I love the idea of marriage. I think it's beautiful. I'm such a romantic, and I always have been.
author: Portia de Rossi

quote: Personally, I can't see why it would be any less romantic to find a husband in a nice four-color catalogue than in the average downtown bar at happy hour.
author: Barbara Ehrenreich

quote: I was married when I was 17. I knew nothing. I was full of romance.
author: Gloria Swanson

quote: It is really rare to find someone you really, really love and that you want to spend your life with and all that stuff that goes along with being married. I am one of those lucky people. And I think she feels that way too. So the romantic stuff is easy because you want them to be happy.
author: Harry Connick, Jr.

quote: I'm not trying to be romantic. I think you can tell when people are trying to be sexy onstage. When I was doing 'All the Way,' I was really thinking about my wife. People don't know my personal experience, but they can tell it's an honest interpretation.
author: Harry Connick, Jr.

quote: I don't have any romantic ideas about marriage. Trust me. A white dress... ? No. It's not something for me.
author: Diane Kruger

quote: Marriage is not simply a romantic union between two people it's also a political and economic contract of the highest order.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quote: The state of New Jersey is really two places - terrible cities and wonderful suburbs. I live in the suburbs, the final battleground of the American dream, where people get married and have kids and try to scratch out a happy life for themselves. It's very romantic in that way, but a bit naive. I like to play with that in my work.
author: Harlan Coben

quote: My husband, Sal, and I put date nights on the calendar once a week. I know that doesn't sound romantic, but otherwise it won't get done.
author: Sherri Shepherd

quote: I have a great wife and it's very easy to be romantic because it makes her happy and then my life is so much better when she's happy.
author: Nicholas Sparks

quote: My wife was the first romantic partner who understood both American and native parts of me - not so much the positive stuff, but the damage.
author: Sherman Alexie

quote: My vanity is I'm terribly romantic! But being married is lovely.
author: Matthew Macfadyen

quote: I was very influenced by the musicals and romantic comedies of the 1930s. I admired Gene Harlow and such, which probably explains why, since the end of my marriage, I've dated nothing but a succession of blondes.
author: Hugh Hefner

quote: I got a gymnastics scholarship to college, fell in love with my true love of my whole life - who I'm married to now - and he was a virgin too. It was very romantic.
author: Victoria Jackson

quote: I think everyone dreams of that nice romantic wedding.
author: Lance Bass

quote: I've been married before, but I've never had my dream wedding in Vegas. I wanted to do it there because it's casual, quick, not religious and, most of all, very romantic.
author: Sinead O'Connor

quote: If I had no family, my wife and I would lead a much more romantic and nomadic existence.
author: David McCallum

quote: I think the institute of marriage is a noble thing. The idea of a partner for life is incredibly romantic. But now we're living to 100. A hundred years ago people were dying at age 37. Til death do us part was a much different deal.
author: Debra Messing

quote: I'd love to do a romantic comedy. And perhaps, if the character was right and I had a good gut instinct, a Bollywood movie. And I'd love to direct. One day. I'm learning a lot on the set of 'The Good Wife.'
author: Archie Panjabi

quote: Once I got married and had kids, I moved away from romantic roles, because it seemed wrong to have my 3-year-old wondering why Daddy was kissing someone else.
author: Chevy Chase

quote: If it's a romantic holiday, the only thing I need is my wife. We love quiet and calm places where we can't be disturbed. Neither of us likes being in busy places we would much rather stay in our hotel room and enjoy each other's company.
author: Jean Reno

quote: My husband does so many romantic things for me, it's absurd.
author: Jennifer Beals

quote: Building a little bonfire at night on the beach and lying on a blanket with my wife under the stars is not only sexy, it's romantic.
author: Benjamin Bratt

quote: The first book I wrote was The Bride Price which was a romantic book, but my husband burnt the book when he saw it. I was the typical African woman, I'd done this privately, I wanted him to look at it, approve it and he said he wouldn't read it.
author: Buchi Emecheta

quote: There's something about marriage that is not as intensely romantic or interesting as a couple's first meeting.
author: John Sandford

quote: The sad truth is that the civil rights movement cannot be reborn until we identify the causes of black suffering, some of them self-inflicted. Why can't black leaders organize rallies around responsible sexuality, birth within marriage, parents reading to their children and students staying in school and doing homework?
author: Henry Louis Gates

quote: I'll always be sad that my marriage ended.
author: Shania Twain

quote: The funny thing is I'm not bothered or sad about being on my own - after all I've never had a husband.
author: Francesca Annis

quote: I would love to be married. But it's not a necessity like the way that I feel I need and want to have children. It would be wonderful to have a husband, and I would feel blessed to do it. But I would feel sad for the rest of my life if I had no kids.
author: Mindy Kaling

quote: As somebody who, in my second marriage, insisted on a prenuptial agreement, I can also testify that sometimes it is an act of love to chart the exit strategy before you enter the union, in order to make sure that not only you, but your partner as well, knows that there will be no World War III should hearts and minds, for any sad reason, change.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quote: What I really tried to do with Helen was make her show this sad side of her. She was married off at 16, was so young and living in this castle that can't leave because of how she looks, and married to a man she hates and three times her age.
author: Diane Kruger

quote: A marriage is no amusement but a solemn act, and generally a sad one.
author: Queen Victoria

quote: I'm incredibly sad that my mother's not here to see my kids and that my kids don't get to know her. And she didn't meet my husband. That's one of the hardest things. I don't even know how to put that into words.
author: Stella McCartney

quote: Our family has gone through a very difficult time. My husband and I have taken the brunt of it. I've never known what it truly felt like to be so sad and desperate inside.
author: Tracey Gold

quote: It is sad that the Republican leadership is not as interested as they say they are in protecting the institution of marriage as they are in waging a campaign to divide and distract the American people from the real issues that need to be addressed.
author: Kendrick Meek

quote: We all had lots of stories of our sad experiences - they mourned the death of my wife with me - but we were hopeful that the children would return.
author: Otto Frank

quote: If you haven't seen your wife smile at a traffic cop, you haven't seen her smile her prettiest.
author: Kin Hubbard

quote: I never laugh or smile when I am writing. When I come home for lunch after writing all morning, my wife says I look like I just came home from a funeral. This is not bragging. This is an illness.
author: Carl Hiaasen

quote: Marriage cannot be severed from its cultural, religious and natural roots without weakening the good influence of society.
author: Jack Kingston

quote: Ages of experience have taught humanity that the commitment of a husband and wife to love and to serve one another promotes the welfare of children and the stability of society.
author: Jack Kingston

quote: I believe the home and marriage is the foundation of our society and must be protected.
author: Billy Graham

quote: I'm also interested in the modern suggestion that you can have a combination of love and sex in a marriage - which no previous society has ever believed.
author: Alain de Botton

quote: I am against marriage, and I don't give a fig for society.
author: Brigitte Bardot

quote: Rude contact with facts chased my visions and dreams quickly away, and in their stead I beheld the horrors, the corruption, the evils and hypocrisy of society, and as I stood among them, a young wife, a great wail of agony went out from my soul.
author: Victoria Woodhull

quote: Well, marriage is a very important part of our culture and our society. If we want to have a hopeful and decent society, we ought to aim for the ideal.
author: Karl Rove

quote: Same-sex marriage would eliminate entirely in law the basic idea of a mother and a father for every child. It would create a society which deliberately chooses to deprive a child of either a mother or a father.
author: Keith O'Brien

quote: Redefining marriage will have huge implications for what is taught in our schools, and for wider society. It will redefine society since the institution of marriage is one of the fundamental building blocks of society. The repercussions of enacting same-sex marriage into law will be immense.
author: Keith O'Brien

quote: The man in our society is the breadwinner the woman has enough to do as the homemaker, wife and mother.
author: Dorothy Fields

quote: Olympism is the marriage of sport and culture.
author: Juan Antonio Samaranch

quote: I come from a sports family and my husband is a rugby player.
author: Kirsty Gallacher

quote: If I could have married my wife and been a sports writer for the past 30 years, I wouldn't be sitting here - but I don't think I'd be sitting someplace where I was sorry to be sitting.
author: Richard Ford

quote: Absolutely the worst thing about this job is the travel and being away from family. I have a wife and three wonderful children, the kids are all active in sports and it's very difficult to up and leave and miss them growing up.
author: Roy Clark

quote: Everybody sort of questioned why we get married on New Year's Day, and of course, the avid sports fans wouldn't come, because they had to watch the Rose Bowl or whatever that is on that day.
author: Yeardley Smith

quote: I'm pretty quiet. But I love to play sports. I like playing all sports. I'll act goofy at times around my wife and my son, around my own family. I like to have fun in general.
author: Steve Blake

quote: Organic buildings are the strength and lightness of the spiders' spinning, buildings qualified by light, bred by native character to environment, married to the ground.
author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quote: Early in the morning, I fell in love with the girl that later on became my wife. At that time, we were so naive. I wanted to charm her, so I read her Capital by Marx. I thought somehow she would be convinced by the strength of his criticism about capital.
author: Shimon Peres

quote: I'm an activist for gay marriage equality and children's rights. I'm the face of Share Our Strength.
author: Sandra Lee

quote: My husband has quite simply been my strength and stay all these years, and I owe him a debt greater than he would ever claim.
author: Queen Elizabeth II

quote: What are my sources of strength? My husband and my three kids, my health-care team, and my religion.
author: Geraldine Ferraro

quote: We managed to hang in there. Today when people get married there's a tendency to run away when things get tough. There is a lot of strength in hanging together.
author: Jerry Stiller

quote: My wife and I have always trusted each other, and I have to thank her strength.
author: Anthony Anderson

quote: Instead, I think over the years we have cut the strength of marriage and relationships by the law and weakened the institution. We have tried to deal with relationships with no-fault divorce, with child custody, with so many other avenues and it has not helped.
author: Timothy Murphy

quote: My husband Rhashan reminds me of my father because he's got great strength of character.
author: Olivia Williams

quote: Tonight I should like to thank all those who have shared my work and to acknowledge the debt that I owe to my wife whose encouragement to put research before all other things has been a great strength to me.
author: George Porter

quote: No man succeeds without a good woman behind him. Wife or mother, if it is both, he is twice blessed indeed.
author: Godfrey Winn

quote: Almost no one is foolish enough to imagine that he automatically deserves great success in any field of activity yet almost everyone believes that he automatically deserves success in marriage.
author: Sydney J. Harris

quote: In Hollywood a marriage is a success if it outlasts milk.
author: Rita Rudner

quote: For marriage to be a success, every woman and every man should have her and his own bathroom. The end.
author: Catherine Zeta-Jones

quote: The manic pursuit of success cost me everything I could love: my wife, my three children, some friends I would have liked to grow old with.
author: Sammy Davis, Jr.

quote: It takes two to make a marriage a success and only one to make it a failure.
author: Herbert Samuel

quote: Married couples who work together to build and maintain a business assume broad responsibilities. Not only is their work important to our local and national economies, but their success is central to the well-being of their families.
author: Melissa Bean

quote: The secrets of success are a good wife and a steady job. My wife told me.
author: Howard Nemerov

quote: Success is hard in general for most women. We now have such busy lives, and we're told we can do everything - you know, we can have the relationship and the marriage and the kids and the career.
author: Cat Deeley

quote: You may lose your wife, you may lose your dog, your mother may hate you. None of those things matter. What matters is that you achieve success and become free. Then you can do whatever you like.
author: Kevin O'Leary

quote: My wife Elizabeth and I started The Really Terrible Orchestra for people like us who are pretty hopeless musicians who would like to play in an orchestra. It has been a great success. We give performances we've become the most famous bad orchestra in the world.
author: Alexander McCall Smith

quote: Staying married may have long-term benefits. You can elicit much more sympathy from friends over a bad marriage than you ever can from a good divorce.
author: P. J. O'Rourke

quote: Marriage must be a relation either of sympathy or of conquest.
author: George Eliot

quote: Okay, so, sometimes in life, I can be a score-keeper - someone who keeps track of what he gives and what he gets in return. An annoying quality, to say the least, and I'm sure my wife has your sympathy, but it's made me highly attuned to when and where credit is due.
author: Mark Feuerstein

quote: Vadim was both my teacher and my husband. I placed myself entirely in his hands.
author: Brigitte Bardot

quote: Every marriage tends to consist of an aristocrat and a peasant. Of a teacher and a learner.
author: John Updike

quote: I was sent to a nice Church of England girls' school and at that time, after university, a woman was expected to become a teacher, a nurse or a missionary - prior to marriage.
author: Kate Adie

quote: From a very early age, my wife and I told our son that there are times and places for everything. I told him, look, when you're in class, you have to be quiet and listen to your teacher, but when you go out to the playground, you can scream and be silly.
author: Mark Hoppus

quote: I always think about which blood drive was going on in Georgia that day when that husband or mom or school teacher rolled up their sleeve and actually gave me a second chance at life. It's the ultimate gift of life, and I'm the one who was on the other end.
author: Niki Taylor

quote: One of the things I've always liked about my husband is he's very good at lots of stuff. He was an English teacher when I met him. He wrote poetry and played the guitar. As time went on, he decided to go into economics, so he's very analytical and mathematical in addition to his artsy side.
author: Ally Condie

quote: We're in a new world. We're in a world in which the possibility of terrorism, married up with technology, could make us very, very sorry that we didn't act.
author: Condoleezza Rice

quote: If we marry educational technology with quality, enriching content, that's a circle of win.
author: LeVar Burton

quote: Realize that a Muslim will know that his wife was seen naked in this machine. You know what would be the reaction?... Terrible. I believe there's technology out there that can identify bomb-type materials without necessarily, overly invading our privacy.
author: Isaac Yeffet

quote: My wife handles all of our technology. So if something goes wrong with the computer, I throw up my arms and step aside while the IT gal figures it out.
author: Ty Burrell

quote: Content and technology are strange bed fellows. We are joined together. Sometimes we misunderstand each other. But isn't that after all the definition of marriage?
author: Howard Stringer

quote: At the end of your life, you will never regret not having passed one more test, not winning one more verdict or not closing one more deal. You will regret time not spent with a husband, a friend, a child, or a parent.
author: Barbara Bush

quote: For years my wedding ring has done its job. It has led me not into temptation. It has reminded my husband numerous times at parties that it's time to go home. It has been a source of relief to a dinner companion. It has been a status symbol in the maternity ward.
author: Erma Bombeck

quote: I guess the real reason that my wife and I had children is the same reason that Napoleon had for invading Russia: it seemed like a good idea at the time.
author: Bill Cosby

quote: I really wanted to retire and rest and spend more time with my children, my grandchildren and of course with my wife.
author: Nelson Mandela

quote: I feel very deeply about the need to respect and tolerate people of different social - or sexual orientation. But at the same time, I believe marriage should be preserved as an institution for one man and one woman.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: My father probably thought the capital of the world was wherever he was at the time. It couldn't possibly be anyplace else. Where he and his wife were in their own home, that, for them, was the capital of the world.
author: Bob Dylan

quote: My view is that marriage is a relationship between a man and a woman. That's the position I've had for some time, and I don't intend to make any adjustments at this point... Or ever, by the way.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: Men have a much better time of it than women. For one thing, they marry later for another thing, they die earlier.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: Culture, what you believe, what you value, how you live matters. Now, as fundamental as these principles are, they may become topics of democratic debates from time to time, so it is today with the enduring institution of marriage. Marriage is a relationship between a man and a woman.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: The secret of a happy marriage is finding the right person. You know they're right if you love to be with them all the time.
author: Julia Child

quote: Some people ask the secret of our long marriage. We take time to go to a restaurant two times a week. A little candlelight, dinner, soft music and dancing. She goes Tuesdays, I go Fridays.
author: Henny Youngman

quote: It's important to take time for your spouse and nurture the relationship.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: It is easier to be a lover than a husband for the simple reason that it is more difficult to be witty every day than to say pretty things from time to time.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: The first time you marry for love, the second for money, and the third for companionship.
author: Jackie Kennedy

quote: My wife and I have so much fun when we travel and find anything... like stray cats and squirrels.
author: Eric Roberts

quote: I've three children, three grandchildren, I work, I travel, and I'm very happily married. I'm very satisfied and happy with my life and there really isn't anything I want.
author: Joan Collins

quote: I was young. I was newly married. And I had worked like a dog. I just wanted to live and travel.
author: Sarah Michelle Gellar

quote: Before we had the kids, my husband and I were traveling a lot and working and really enjoying our lives and each other. We both love the theater and books and travel and so we were really having a lot of fun.
author: Patricia Heaton

quote: Then I was lucky I met with my future husband, and I started new life with my husband, and I was happy again. He was a musician. I start to travel with him through Europe also and around the former Soviet Union.
author: Olga Korbut

quote: Yes, I travel in unusual circles. George Osborne and his wife Frances are my cousins.
author: Daryl Hall

quote: I only travel to good material, a good director and a good company. I won't work in another country for a year any longer, because I have a lovely wife and I adore her and I can't bear to be away from her.
author: Jim Dale

quote: Absolutely the worst thing about this job is the travel and being away from family. I have a wife and three wonderful children, the kids are all active in sports and it's very difficult to up and leave and miss them growing up.
author: Roy Clark

quote: Never trust a husband too far, nor a bachelor too near.
author: Helen Rowland

quote: For it is mutual trust, even more than mutual interest that holds human associations together. Our friends seldom profit us but they make us feel safe. Marriage is a scheme to accomplish exactly that same end.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: A wedding anniversary is the celebration of love, trust, partnership, tolerance and tenacity. The order varies for any given year.
author: Paul Sweeney

quote: Even in the common affairs of life, in love, friendship, and marriage, how little security have we when we trust our happiness in the hands of others!
author: William Hazlitt

quote: Don't expect anyone else to support you. Maybe you'll have a trust fund. Maybe you'll have a wealthy spouse. But you never know when either of them might run out.
author: Mary Schmich

quote: My wife, a schoolteacher, very disciplined. If you think I'm tough, trust me, and wait till you see when the children are on the naughty step. It's hilarious. So we decided that I'm going to work like a donkey and provide amazing support for the family.
author: Gordon Ramsay

quote: I don't have any romantic ideas about marriage. Trust me. A white dress... ? No. It's not something for me.
author: Diane Kruger

quote: My wife and I have built trust with our children and have always had open communication.
author: Rick Springfield

quote: I guess as long as people think of me for different ages, I'll trust their opinion. I remember noticing one year that Michelle Monaghan played 34 and 19, so I've kind of clung to that as my justification that I can be Jake Gyllenhaal's wife and a freshman in college in the same year.
author: Anna Kendrick

quote: As an alcoholic, you have no appreciation for your wife or your children's feelings, but I'm making up for that now. I'm winning my children's trust back.
author: Maurice Gibb

quote: Bronagh looks after the kids and without her the family would disintegrate... there are some things you can't discuss with anyone other than your wife. There has to be a strong bond of trust.
author: John Key

quote: I had a career and I came to motherhood late and am not married and have never had such a trusting relationship with a man - and trust is where the real power of love comes from.
author: Diane Keaton

quote: I went through a long period of time in that marriage when I didn't believe anything was my fault. I had to face what my part was, and only because of that difficult work was I able to trust a man again.
author: Connie Sellecca

quote: I don't trust that many people. Just my mother and my wife and a couple of friends. When I trust people, it doesn't end well.
author: Gary Sheffield

quote: Clearly, if it is sensible to hold a referendum on independence, it is crucial that we have one on marriage. It is the only way the country can move forward on this issue. Let all those who have a view on this subject place their trust in the Scottish people and let Scotland decide.
author: Keith O'Brien

quote: Nobody has ever denied that when it comes to his trade - gigolo - John Forbes Kerry is one of the all-time greats. He's in the Gigolo Hall of Fame. See, a really good gigolo might snag one heiress in a lifetime with a nine-figure trust fund. Kerry has married two. When it comes to gigolos, he's Steve Jobs.
author: Howie Carr

quote: I guess because it feels more open, but I think being married is way sexier, because it's really like your soul partner in a permanent fashion, and then you strive for it to be something permanent, and that type of commitment and trust, if you can achieve it, is so good for the soul.
author: Leelee Sobieski

quote: I trust my wife more than I trust myself.
author: Chris Paul

quote: It's good to have a manager who shares your interests, or goals. You can presumably trust a husband. I don't know if it's the best way to work. I really shouldn't discuss this.
author: Dorothy Stratten

quote: Strike an average between what a woman thinks of her husband a month before she marries him and what she thinks of him a year afterward, and you will have the truth about him.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: I told my wife the truth. I told her I was seeing a psychiatrist. Then she told me the truth: that she was seeing a psychiatrist, two plumbers, and a bartender.
author: Rodney Dangerfield

quote: Romantic love is an illusion. Most of us discover this truth at the end of a love affair or else when the sweet emotions of love lead us into marriage and then turn down their flames.
author: Thomas Moore

quote: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.
author: Jane Austen

quote: The sad truth is that the civil rights movement cannot be reborn until we identify the causes of black suffering, some of them self-inflicted. Why can't black leaders organize rallies around responsible sexuality, birth within marriage, parents reading to their children and students staying in school and doing homework?
author: Henry Louis Gates

quote: Marriage is an adventure, like going to war.
author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quote: When there's a war, people get married.
author: Doris Lessing

quote: My mother had a son from previous marriage and her husband died in Second World War.
author: Mikhail Baryshnikov

quote: As somebody who, in my second marriage, insisted on a prenuptial agreement, I can also testify that sometimes it is an act of love to chart the exit strategy before you enter the union, in order to make sure that not only you, but your partner as well, knows that there will be no World War III should hearts and minds, for any sad reason, change.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quote: My mother was the first woman in the county in Indiana where we were born, in Jay County, to have a college degree. She was educated as a pianist and she wanted to concertize, but when the war came she was married, had a family, so she started teaching.
author: Twyla Tharp

quote: Never advise anyone to go to war or to get married. Write down the advice of him who loves you, though you like it not at present. He that has no children brings them up well.
author: Germaine Greer

quote: The real act of marriage takes place in the heart, not in the ballroom or church or synagogue. It's a choice you make - not just on your wedding day, but over and over again - and that choice is reflected in the way you treat your husband or wife.
author: Barbara de Angelis

quote: My advice to you is get married: if you find a good wife you'll be happy if not, you'll become a philosopher.
author: Socrates

quote: It's a funny thing that when a man hasn't anything on earth to worry about, he goes off and gets married.
author: Robert Frost

quote: I was married by a judge. I should have asked for a jury.
author: Groucho Marx

quote: A young bride is like a plucked flower but a guilty wife is like a flower that had been walked over.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: I am about to be married, and am of course in all the misery of a man in pursuit of happiness.
author: Lord Byron

quote: I have great hopes that we shall love each other all our lives as much as if we had never married at all.
author: Lord Byron

quote: Our dog died from licking our wedding picture.
author: Phyllis Diller

quote: A woman seldom asks advice before she has bought her wedding clothes.
author: Joseph Addison

quote: A bride at her second marriage does not wear a veil. She wants to see what she is getting.
author: Helen Rowland

quote: An invitation to a wedding invokes more trouble than a summons to a police court.
author: William Feather

quote: A wedding is just like a funeral except that you get to smell your own flowers.
author: Grace Hansen

quote: I'd imagine my wedding as a fairy tale... huge, beautiful and white.
author: Paris Hilton

quote: Women who marry early are often overly enamored of the kind of man who looks great in wedding pictures and passes the maid of honor his telephone number.
author: Anna Quindlen

quote: When the wedding march sounds the resolute approach, the clock no longer ticks, it tolls the hour. The figures in the aisle are no longer individuals, they symbolize the human race.
author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

quote: A gloomy guest fits not a wedding feast.
author: Friedrich Schiller

quote: When I design a wedding dress with a bustle, it has to be one the bride can dance in. I love the idea that something is practical and still looks great.
author: Vera Wang

quote: Monica Seles: I'd hate to be next door to her on her wedding night.
author: Peter Ustinov

quote: The press is just not your friend when it comes to a marriage. That's why we didn't sell the pictures of our wedding, and we got offered millions of dollars for them, millions.
author: Katy Perry

quote: When it's over, I want to say: all my life I was a bride married to amazement. I was the bridegroom, taking the world into my arms.
author: Mary Oliver

quote: I sang a song at my sister's wedding. My mother forced me into that, too. But that one felt all right.
author: Adam Sandler

quote: Getting married, for me, was the best thing I ever did. I was suddenly beset with an immense sense of release, that we have something more important than our separate selves, and that is the marriage. There's immense happiness that can come from working towards that.
author: Nick Cave

quote: When I decided to get married at 40, I couldn't find a dress with the modernity or sophistication I wanted. That's when I saw the opportunity for a wedding gown business.
author: Vera Wang

quote: The first thing I did when I sold my book was buy a new wedding ring for my wife and asked her to marry me all over again.
author: Nicholas Sparks

quote: The Wedding March always reminds me of the music played when soldiers go into battle.
author: Heinrich Heine

quote: I chose my wife, as she did her wedding gown, for qualities that would wear well.
author: Oliver Goldsmith

quote: In the '50s, a lot of girls never saw beyond the wedding day.
author: Helen Reddy

quote: It was only literally hours after the wedding when he felt he didn't have to keep up the facade.
author: Trisha Goddard

quote: I don't know nothing about no marriages or nothing. I ain't even never been to a wedding.
author: Mike Epps

quote: Personally, I'm an advocate for short engagements. Long sometimes means there is a reason for it. Two years engaged and no wedding... I'd be upset.
author: Emily Blunt

quote: A wedding is such a girl thing.
author: Selma Blair

quote: No jealousy their dawn of love overcast, nor blasted were their wedded days with strife each season looked delightful as it past, to the fond husband and the faithful wife.
author: James Beattie

quote: I really did put up all my wedding pictures on my website. And I swear to you, my wedding pictures got downloaded just as much as my bikini pictures.
author: Cindy Margolis

quote: People always complain, 'you never invited me to your wedding', but I prefer casual weddings.
author: Sinead O'Connor

quote: Never get married in the morning - you never know who you might meet that night.
author: Paul Hornung

quote: The Wedding March has a bit of a death march in it.
author: Brian May

quote: And we've got a toaster and everything. So there is no reason for the wedding.
author: Karl Pilkington

quote: I want the big drama. I always said I don't want a wedding I want a parade.
author: Star Jones

quote: When he came back from downtown, he had forgotten to bring his license, his identification, the $2 for the wedding license. So we got married two days later.
author: Eydie Gorme

quote: I get very nervous when I have to take my wedding ring off.
author: Jerry O'Connell

quote: The one thing that I'm in charge of in this wedding is the food.
author: Rob Mariano

quote: Saw a wedding in the church. It was strange to see what delight we married people have to see these poor fools decoyed into our condition.
author: Samuel Pepys

quote: You may invite the entire 35th Division to your wedding if you want to. I guess it's going to be yours as well as mine. We might as well have the church full while we are at it.
author: Bess Truman

quote: No wedding bells for me anymore. I've been happily married to my profession for years.
author: Shirley Bassey

quote: For years my wedding ring has done its job. It has led me not into temptation. It has reminded my husband numerous times at parties that it's time to go home. It has been a source of relief to a dinner companion. It has been a status symbol in the maternity ward.
author: Erma Bombeck

quote: I've been looking at some video clips on YouTube of President Obama - then candidate Obama - going through Iowa making promises. The gap between his promises and his performance is the largest I've seen, well, since the Kardashian wedding and the promise of 'til death do we part.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: A wedding anniversary is the celebration of love, trust, partnership, tolerance and tenacity. The order varies for any given year.
author: Paul Sweeney

quote: A wedding is a funeral where you smell your own flowers.
author: Eddie Cantor

quote: In marriage there are no manners to keep up, and beneath the wildest accusations no real criticism. Each is familiar with that ancient child in the other who may erupt again. We are not ridiculous to ourselves. We are ageless. That is the luxury of the wedding ring.
author: Enid Bagnold

quote: Wedding: the point at which a man stops toasting a woman and begins roasting her.
author: Helen Rowland

quote: I've always been the type to fall in love fast and, with every boyfriend, I plan out my wedding in my head.
author: Kim Kardashian

quote: We were pretty good mates until the Beatles started to split up and Yoko came into it. It was more like old army buddies splitting up on account of wedding bells.
author: Paul McCartney

quote: One tradition I have with my friends is that when one of us gets married, we have a ton of fragrance oils and pretty bottles at the bachelorette party. Everyone puts a drop or two in a bottle for the bride and makes a wish, and the bride wears our creation on her wedding day.
author: Jennifer Aniston

quote: The most dangerous food is wedding cake.
author: James Thurber

quote: I did get to keep the wedding dresses from 'Runaway Bride'. They're all boxed up in my garage. I've never opened them. It'll be fun one day when Hazel is taller. She can play dress-up with her friends.
author: Julia Roberts

quote: My father always wanted to be the corpse at every funeral, the bride at every wedding and the baby at every christening.
author: Alice Roosevelt Longworth

quote: I want a big church wedding.
author: Sienna Miller

quote: I wanted to define the vocabulary of a wedding both visually and intellectually. The book is about more than weddings or wedding dresses. It's a metaphor for women's lives, their creativity.
author: Vera Wang

quote: I think a lot of people who feel as though they desperately want to be married oftentimes simply desperately want to have a wedding.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quote: A man's got two shots for jewelry: a wedding ring and a watch. The watch is a lot easier to get on and off than a wedding ring.
author: John Mayer

quote: I don't ever really feel that wearing my wedding ring is what determines me being married or not.
author: Jessica Simpson

quote: I think if you're at the point where you're popular enough to sell your wedding photos to OK! Magazine then you don't need the money.
author: Johnny Vegas

quote: I've been sober for two-and-a-half years, My children are happy. In August, my wife and I will celebrate our fifteenth wedding anniversary. My band is back together with a sold-out tour.
author: Trey Anastasio

quote: There was no relationship between a wedding dress and fashion. There was no good taste, either. I realized that I could make an impression in terms of changing and readdressing the whole industry of bridal.
author: Vera Wang

quote: I love a black wedding dress.
author: Vera Wang

quote: I hadn't been in Vegas 20 minutes when I got word that the bookmakers were offering three to one that Frank wouldn't show for my wedding.
author: Sammy Davis, Jr.

quote: I've never crashed a wedding. When I was a kid I, of course, used to crash parties. Crashing a wedding is difficult though because you have to have the suit, and you have to have information in case someone catches you. You have to know at least some names and something.
author: Christopher Walken

quote: I try to remember, as I hear about friends getting engaged, that it's not about the ring and it's not about the wedding. It's a grave thing, getting married. And it's easy to get swept up in the wrong things.
author: Gwyneth Paltrow

quote: I met Prince William at a musical festival and he let me know he was a fan of my music. But the invitation to sing at his wedding reception came completely out of the blue. The fact that Kate and William knew the words to my songs was very touching.
author: Ellie Goulding

quote: I hated the royal wedding.
author: Steven Patrick Morrissey

quote: I was never a girl who dreamed about what her wedding day would be like, but I've always dreamed about decorating my baby's nursery.
author: Rebecca Romijn

quote: I use filming as an excuse to take classes. I got my certification in sailing for 'Wedding Crashers,' and now I can handle a 26-foot boat. I played a seamstress once, so I took sewing classes. I love dipping into these other lives.
author: Rachel McAdams

quote: I love auditioning. Since 'The Notebook' and 'Wedding Crashers,' I don't have to audition anymore, and I miss it. You get to show your interpretation of the character. I get nervous when I don't audition. What if they hate what I want to do?
author: Rachel McAdams

quote: Wedding is destiny, and hanging likewise.
author: John Heywood

quote: I would absolutely, definitely never sell my wedding pictures to a magazine. I'd like it to be a special day, not a photo shoot. And once you've done that, your marriage becomes everybody else's business.
author: Katherine Jenkins

quote: All the information you could want is constantly streaming at you like a runaway truck - books, newspaper stories, Web sites, apps, how-to videos, this article you're reading, even entire magazines devoted to single subjects like charcuterie or wedding cakes or pickles.
author: Mario Batali

quote: I only did karaoke once in my life. It was with Courtney Love and it was a total disaster. She pulled me on stage in front of 500 people at a wedding. I'd never done karaoke before.
author: Jared Leto

quote: The wedding took place in Vermont, where they have legalized gay civil unions, and I married a woman.
author: Craig Ferguson

quote: I am usually part of any disaster at a wedding if I'm a bridesmaid, which I've been lucky enough to be several times.
author: Jennifer Garner

quote: I think a lot of people get so obsessed with the wedding and the expense of the wedding that they miss out on what the real purpose is. It's not about a production number, it's about a meaningful moment between two people that's witnessed by people that they actually really know and care about.
author: Jane Seymour

quote: I love doing comedy. Absolutely love it. After 'Wedding Crashers,' people suddenly realized that it was something I could do.
author: Jane Seymour

quote: It's interesting because a lot of my 16-year-old kids' friends know me from 'Wedding Crashers,' and not so much Bond. My kids have a good laugh. I was 20 then. The look I had then was the look that a lot of their friends are assuming now. They think it's cool. What goes around comes around.
author: Jane Seymour

quote: When I auditioned for 'Wedding Crashers,' the producers had never seen any of my other work except for Bond. I got 'Wedding Crashers' partly because I was a Bond girl.
author: Jane Seymour

quote: When I planned my wedding the first time, my ex-husband and I, we were both struggling comics. I had a TV show that had gotten cancelled. Basically, I rented a wedding gown the reception hall smelled like feet.
author: Sherri Shepherd

quote: For my first wedding, I cried all the way down the aisle. My fake eyelash came off. My nose was red. My eyes were swollen. I'm not one of those pretty criers.
author: Sherri Shepherd

quote: A big part of being in a wedding is the financial obligation, and that's something that people don't really talk about, but if you're asked to be in a wedding, you're gonna have to fork over some cash.
author: Kristen Wiig

quote: The only time I ever look good dancing is if I'm next to my dad at a wedding.
author: Cat Deeley

quote: For me, life has either been a wake or a wedding.
author: Peter O'Toole

quote: I hope that when I'm 80 years old, people will still be talking about my wedding.
author: Jennifer Hudson

quote: Well, I'll tell you something, this wedding is something that I will always, always cherish. It was a show of love and support and kindness like I'd never seen from the people, and that's who I entertain. I entertain the people.
author: Liza Minnelli

quote: The wedding ring on my left hand was bought by my grandfather, Samuel Miliband, in Brussels in 1920. I never knew him, as he died when I was one. But his ring was kept by my aunt until it was placed on my finger by my wife Louise 32 years later.
author: David Miliband

quote: Most kids don't get to go their parents' wedding.
author: Kenneth Robert Livingstone

quote: My husband, Jim, converted to Judaism just before our wedding.
author: Anita Diament

quote: When widows exclaim loudly against second marriages, I would always lay a wager than the man, If not the wedding day, is absolutely fixed on.
author: Henry Fielding

quote: When I had a job catering, I catered a wedding for the Smashing Pumpkins bassist in Indiana. And I served Billy Corgan shrimp off a tray.
author: Amy Poehler

quote: I saw a photograph of a wedding conducted by Reverend Moon of the Unification Church. I wanted to understand this event, and the only way to understand it was to write about it.
author: Don DeLillo

quote: On the publicity tour of 'My Big Fat Greek Wedding,' I was asked over and over again, if, as the writer, I felt it was a fair depiction of real life to have someone of my er, below average looks, hook up with hottie John Corbett.
author: Nia Vardalos

quote: I thought I was attractive when I shot 'My Big Fat Greek Wedding.' Studio executives and movie reviewers let me know I had a confidence in my looks that was not shared by them.
author: Nia Vardalos

quote: On my wedding day. I didn't want a natural, blushing-bride look - I had a full-on hairdo and red lips. I thought it would be disingenuous to do the whole virginal look, so even though I had the white dress, I had pink net underneath.
author: Sophie Ellis Bextor

quote: She tells enough white lies to ice a wedding cake.
author: Margot Asquith

quote: I think everyone dreams of that nice romantic wedding.
author: Lance Bass

quote: I just wrapped this movie called The Wedding Crashers which was a pretty big break for me.
author: Bradley Cooper

quote: My family is almost exactly like the one in 'Monsoon Wedding'. We are very open, fairly liberal, loud people.
author: Mira Nair

quote: It gave me a lot of pleasure and pride that 90 percent of the crew for 'Monsoon Wedding,' and most of my film, are women. We get the work done, you know, much lesser play of ego... And I really believe in harmony, I believe in working in a spirit of egolessness and that the film is bigger than all of us.
author: Mira Nair

quote: My wedding was at home, so I didn't really want to wear a veil in my house. Instead I wore a lot of diamond hair clips. They were brooches, actually, designed by Lorraine Schwartz.
author: Georgina Chapman

quote: I didn't finish my dress until about three days before my wedding - I had the flu and was stitching it from my bed. And the tulle came back from India all brown. We had to wash it for hours, but that didn't dissuade me from wearing it.
author: Georgina Chapman

quote: I've been married before, but I've never had my dream wedding in Vegas. I wanted to do it there because it's casual, quick, not religious and, most of all, very romantic.
author: Sinead O'Connor

quote: I'm a jewelry girl. I became with friends with designer Irene Neuwirth a few years ago. At that point, I just used to wear my wedding rings. Very low key. Now, if I could, I'd be draped from head to toe in her jewelry all the time. Everything she makes is beautiful.
author: Busy Philipps

quote: Well the wedding in the words of the Archbishop of Canterbury was a fairy tale and there was a huge public impress, investment of goodwill, affection and indeed money in this Institution. It was a huge success at the time.
author: Anthony Holden

quote: I don't think it's possible to have a wedding without it being stressful!
author: Debra Messing

quote: I don't follow trends. I make each cake for a particular wedding, or event.
author: Ron Ben-Israel

quote: I don't want a huge wedding. I don't want it to be some huge spectacle.
author: Kristin Cavallari

quote: Where does it stop? You get offered money for your wedding, then for your kids, new houses, holidays... We earn enough from football and sponsorships, why do you need any more?
author: Ryan Giggs

quote: A lawyer I once knew told me of a strange case, a suffragette who had never married. After her death, he opened her trunk and discovered 50 wedding gowns.
author: Marguerite Young

quote: If I felt, in the event of a royal wedding, inspired to write about people coming together in marriage or civil partnership, I would just be grateful to have an idea for the poem. And if I didn't, I'd ignore it.
author: Carol Ann Duffy

quote: Jody Hill, who I created 'Eastbound And Down' and 'Fist Foot Way' with, was my best man at my wedding.
author: Danny McBride

quote: When planning your wedding you make so many decisions: 'Do I want this fork or that fork?' But in the end people aren't going to remember what napkin holder you choose.
author: Lara Stone

quote: Recently, I was in Bernalda, my dad's ancestral home town in Italy. He has just refurbished a palazzo and turned it into a hotel, so we had my sister's wedding there. It was beautiful.
author: Roman Coppola

quote: That to me was the most poignant part of Diana's wedding as she was walking up the aisle and her eyes were going left to right, looking at people and smiling in the way that Diana did - and that diamond tiara glittering like mad. It was great.
author: Bruce Oldfield

quote: I went looking for dresses and realized there was a niche I could fill in the wedding dress market.
author: Monique Lhuillier

quote: As a pastor, you get invited into the most poignant moments of people's lives. Whether it's a wedding or a funeral or a hospital visit, you get invited into the center of the event, whether or not you know the people.
author: Rob Bell

quote: It happened in Miami, in Coral Gables, a great big ol' Cuban wedding. It was pretty intense.
author: Jon Secada

quote: One time when somebody showed up in a wedding dress, but I never knew if it was a joke, or she was serious. She asked me to marry her. She was serious. It was pretty funny.
author: Bryan White

quote: 'That's What She Said' is not Hollywood's standard picture of women: preternaturally gorgeous, wedding obsessed, boy crazy, fashion focused, sexed up 'girl' women. These are real women, comically portrayed, who are trying to wrestle with the very expectations of womanhood that Hollywood movies set up.
author: Carrie Preston

quote: I got my first big paycheck for 'My Best Friend's Wedding.' This was in the days when you actually did get paid to have a supporting role. It just doesn't happen like that anymore, but this was in the '90s. It was the golden age!
author: Carrie Preston

quote: For her fifth wedding, the bride wore black and carried a scotch and soda.
author: Phyllis Battelle

quote: After I had the Caesarean, I was told I had really strong stomach muscles and so would heal very quickly. And I did. I was up walking about within three hours. Six days after having her, I was out shopping and shortly after that I made it to David Walliams' wedding.
author: Denise Van Outen

quote: We all went to Kelsey's wedding, and yeah, we go to parties. We also go to each other's house. A group of us got together over at Kelsey's and just read through some plays just for the fun of it. That may not be everyone's idea of a good time, but we had a good time.
author: David Hyde Pierce

quote: I had a 2-week courtship with a fellow student in the fiction workshop in Iowa and a 5-minute wedding in a lawyer's office above the coffee shop where we'd been having lunch that day. And so I sent a cable to my father saying, 'By the time you get this, Daddy, I'll already be Mrs. Blaise!'
author: Bharati Mukherjee

quote: I've chosen my wedding ring large and heavy to continue forever. But exactly because of that all the time that Dave and I have an argument I feel it like handcuffs, and on anger time I throw it in a basket. Poor Dave, he bought me three wedding rings already!
author: Carmen Miranda

quote: When I celebrated my bar mitzvah, there was no cake. Today, there is no such thing as a bar mitzvah in the United States without a special cake. It can be even more complicated and expensive than a wedding cake, because bar-mitzvah cakes are often based on a particular theme.
author: Ron Ben-Israel

quote: I have a crusade against fondant, also shortening. There's no reason why wedding cakes can't taste good if you know what you're doing.
author: Ron Ben-Israel

quote: I'll get pretty much everything the way I want it. I've always dreamed of a beach wedding.
author: Nicole Appleton

quote: I'd hesitated to have a wedding because my gay and lesbian friends don't have that right.
author: Kathy Najimy

quote: It has been the experience of a lifetime to work with Catherine Middleton to create her wedding dress, and I have enjoyed every moment of it. It was such an incredible honor to be asked, and I am so proud of what we and the Alexander McQueen team have created.
author: Sarah Burton

quote: For a girl, the wedding is when you're married. For a guy, it's when you get engaged. It takes a real aggressive human being to back out between the ring and the wedding.
author: Max Greenfield

quote: I like wearing my wedding ring, it's nice.
author: Jerry O'Connell

quote: Well... Actually I got picked because I was the only one who fit the wedding gown - they had my size.
author: Kevin McDonald

quote: When I was in high school, there was 'Superbad' and 'The Girl Next Door' and 'Wedding Crashers' and all these great movies. You hope to be a part of something that's smart, funny and in that Todd Phillips-vein. You want to make something like 'Superbad.' That movie was so good and so funny.
author: Miles Teller

quote: I used to work all the time, and now if there is a wedding, there's a concert, I'm there.
author: Petra Nemcova

quote: My biggest blast-off hit was 'You Raise Me Up.' If you ever have a wedding or a funeral, it's a good pick.
author: Josh Groban

quote: I feel as though my career really hit its high point when I was cast as a supporting actress in 'American Wedding'. I thought the script had a lot of depth and intelligence, and it really just jumped off the page.
author: January Jones

quote: If you're going to plan a wedding, then a certain amount of suffering is not a choice.
author: Ellie Kemper

quote: Growing up, I had one very specific idea of what a wedding should be, and that was the wedding of Fraulein Maria and Captain von Trapp in 'The Sound of Music.'
author: Ellie Kemper

quote: I was a bridesmaid at a wedding in one picture.
author: Dorothy Malone

quote: I was the official wedding photographer at one of my best friends' weddings. Fortunately she was one of the most easygoing brides ever, so she made it easy for me.
author: Natalie Coughlin

quote: When Andrew went with the girls, we were talking all morning and he was saying, 'It's okay. Just remember we had such a good day. Our wedding was so perfect.' Because we're such a unit together. He made me feel very part of the day on April the 29th.
author: Sarah Ferguson

quote: I wear my wedding ring. We talk about when we're going to get married again, which we hope is going to take place some time in this incredibly hectic calendar year.
author: Jim Lampley

quote: It's important to still look like yourself on your wedding day, so I didn't do anything drastic.
author: Lily Aldridge

quote: A lot of people think I'm that guy in 'Betsy's Wedding', but I'm not. What it is for me is that, on some level, I connect with the character emotionally.
author: Anthony LaPaglia

quote: I felt very unstressed on my wedding day. I'm very grateful for that... spending the day on my own, being super quiet and happy and just puttering around doing my own thing.
author: Sonya Walger

quote: I believe that anybody who gets married should go to a counselor for months before the wedding. I think that's going to save guys a lot of money and the ladies a lot of heartbreak.
author: James Brolin

quote: I've thought about it a hundred times. I even buy bridal magazines sometimes. I want David Tutera to do my wedding.
author: Marlen Esparza

quote: The day of the wedding went like these things generally do, full of anxious moments interspersed with black comedy.
author: Janet Street-Porter

quote: My grandfather Frank Lloyd Wright wore a red sash on his wedding night. That is glamour!
author: Anne Baxter

quote: You have to make your wedding day all about you.
author: DJ Jazzy Jeff

quote: I'm taking one thing at a time. With the children and launching my solo career it would drive me to a nervous breakdown if I tried to organise a wedding on top of that.
author: Natasha Hamilton

quote: I mean, I do wear a wedding ring and take it off when I shoot.
author: Henry Ian Cusick

quote: Those are the men who will dance at your wedding.
author: Guy Madison

quote: There are three faithful friends - an old wife, an old dog, and ready money.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: I am thinking of taking a fifth wife. Why not? Solomon had a thousand wives and he is a synonym for wisdom.
author: John Barrymore

quote: What is the price of experience? Do men buy it for a song? Or wisdom for a dance in the street? No, it is bought with the price of all the man hath, his house, his wife, his children.
author: William Blake

quote: I'm married. My wife, Stella - a beautiful woman. She's brought a lot of peace to my life, a lot of wisdom.
author: Anthony Hopkins

quote: They see me as being this Super Mom on TV who also can more than handle a difficult husband, and they assume I'm going to be just full of wisdom as a mother and wife myself.
author: Patricia Richardson

quote: If women were particular about men's characters, they would never get married at all.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: The only really happy folk are married women and single men.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: I've yet to be on a campus where most women weren't worrying about some aspect of combining marriage, children, and a career. I've yet to find one where many men were worrying about the same thing.
author: Gloria Steinem

quote: All women should know how to take care of children. Most of them will have a husband some day.
author: Franklin P. Jones

quote: Some of us are becoming the men we wanted to marry.
author: Gloria Steinem

quote: Women today have more of an overview of their lives and how marriage is or is not a part of it.
author: Helen Reddy

quote: Men marry because they are tired women, because they are curious both are disappointed.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Bachelors know more about women than married men if they didn't they'd be married too.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: I have noticed... that men usually leave married women alone and are inclined to treat all wives with respect. This is no great credit to married women.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: The man who loves other countries as much as his own stands on a level with the man who loves other women as much as he loves his own wife.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

quote: Marriage is for women the commonest mode of livelihood, and the total amount of undesired sex endured by women is probably greater in marriage than in prostitution.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: Men have a much better time of it than women. For one thing, they marry later for another thing, they die earlier.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: If you cannot work on the marriage or the women is a moron, staying married and cheating makes the most sense because divorce is disruptive to the family life and your bank account.
author: Al Goldstein

quote: Aristotle maintained that women have fewer teeth than men although he was twice married, it never occurred to him to verify this statement by examining his wives' mouths.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: I've only slept with men I've been married to. How many women can make that claim?
author: Elizabeth Taylor

quote: The desire to get married, which - I regret to say, I believe is basic and primal in women - is followed almost immediately by an equally basic and primal urge - which is to be single again.
author: Nora Ephron

quote: A woman asking 'Am I good? Am I satisfied?' is extremely selfish. The less women fuss about themselves, the less they talk to other women, the more they try to please their husbands, the happier the marriage is going to be.
author: Barbara Cartland

quote: Women desire six things: They want their husbands to be brave, wise, rich, generous, obedient to wife, and lively in bed.
author: Geoffrey Chaucer

quote: I do not consider divorce an evil by any means. It is just as much a refuge for women married to brutal men as Canada was to the slaves of brutal masters.
author: Susan B. Anthony

quote: Strong women only marry weak men.
author: Bette Davis

quote: In mid-life the man wants to see how irresistible he still is to younger women. How they turn their hearts to stone and more or less commit a murder of their marriage I just don't know, but they do.
author: Earl Warren

quote: The breakdown of the black community, in order to maintain slavery, began with the breakdown of the black family. Men and women were not legally allowed to get married because you couldn't have that kind of love. It might get in the way of the economics of slavery. Your children could be taken from you and literally sold down the river.
author: Kerry Washington

quote: Women who marry early are often overly enamored of the kind of man who looks great in wedding pictures and passes the maid of honor his telephone number.
author: Anna Quindlen

quote: Feminism is dated? Yes, for privileged women like my daughter and all of us here today, but not for most of our sisters in the rest of the world who are still forced into premature marriage, prostitution, forced labor - they have children that they don't want or they cannot feed.
author: Isabel Allende

quote: A Code of Honor: Never approach a friend's girlfriend or wife with mischief as your goal. There are just too many women in the world to justify that sort of dishonorable behavior. Unless she's really attractive.
author: Bruce Jay Friedman

quote: I didn't want to be one of those women who wake up at 63 years old and realize they've missed the window of opportunity for marriage and children.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: Mr. DeMille's theory of sexual difference was that marriage is an artificial state for women. The want to be taken, ruled, raped. That was his theory.
author: Hedy Lamarr

quote: After about 20 years of marriage, I'm finally starting to scratch the surface of what women want. And I think the answer lies somewhere between conversation and chocolate.
author: Mel Gibson

quote: The trouble with some women is that they get all excited about nothing - and then marry him.
author: Cher

quote: I think that men know how to romance a woman and most do it well, at least for a time, otherwise women wouldn't marry them. The problem is that most of them begin to rest on their laurels.
author: Nicholas Sparks

quote: When you see what some women marry, you realize how they must hate to work for a living.
author: Helen Rowland

quote: I don't know how it is for women or for other guys, but when I was young and in my 20s, I had a fear of marriage.
author: Jeff Bridges

quote: I think women get caught up too much in having a plan - 'I'm going to get married at this age I'm going to have a kid at this age' - and then they just try to find a guy who will fit into that picture. I don't want my life to be based on that.
author: Julia Stiles

quote: People don't have fortunes left them in that style nowadays men have to work and women to marry for money. It's a dreadfully unjust world.
author: Louisa May Alcott

quote: I met an American woman and got married so I had to get a job.
author: Walter Wager

quote: As a housewife, I feel that if the kids are still alive when my husband gets home from work, then hey, I've done my job.
author: Roseanne Barr

quote: If you cannot work on the marriage or the women is a moron, staying married and cheating makes the most sense because divorce is disruptive to the family life and your bank account.
author: Al Goldstein

quote: I think what makes our marriage work amid all the glare is that my husband is my best friend. He inspires everything in my life and enables me to do the best that I can. I want to hang out with him more than anyone.
author: Faith Hill

quote: Why does a woman work ten years to change a man's habits and then complain that he's not the man she married?
author: Barbra Streisand

quote: I think the best thing I can do is to be a distraction. A husband lives and breathes his work all day long. If he comes home to more table thumping, how can the poor man ever relax?
author: Jackie Kennedy

quote: I'm so wrapped up in my work that it's often impossible to consider other things in my life. My marriage ended in divorce because of this, my relationship with Holly has suffered by this.
author: Jim Carrey

quote: I love my wife and I know she loves me. We're best friends. We're just lucky to have found each other. It takes a lot of work but I just feel very blessed that I found the right person. It's a very fortunate situation and not everyone has that.
author: Harry Connick, Jr.

quote: But I have a good life. I enjoy what I do. I am married to work.
author: Henry Rollins

quote: I just get things done instead of talking about getting them done. I don't go out and party. I don't smoke, drink or do drugs and I'm not married, that leaves a lot of time for my work.
author: Henry Rollins

quote: But marriage goes in waves. You've got to be patient. People bail and give up on their marriages way too early. They just don't put the work and the effort into it. You've got to suck up your ego a lot of times, because that can be a big downfall.
author: Anna Benson

quote: I think like any marriage, especially when you've had divorced parents like myself you want to try even harder to make it work.
author: Princess Diana

quote: But the key to our marriage is the capacity to give each other a break. And to realize that it's not how our similarities work together it's how our differences work together.
author: Michael J. Fox

quote: I was looking for a husband, but meanwhile to survive, I had to work.
author: Helen Reddy

quote: My wife, whenever I'd go off to work and I'd be kind of anxious, she'll say, 'Remember, have fun.' Oh, I forgot, thanks for the reminder. Because sometimes we do forget. We take it all too seriously and there's a lot of joy to be had wherever you are.
author: Jeff Bridges

quote: The average husband enjoys the total effect of his home but is usually unable to contribute any of the details of work and organisation that make it enjoyable.
author: Havelock Ellis

quote: The best Christmas present I got from my husband was a week to do whatever I wanted.
author: Olivia Williams

quote: I'm Jewish and my wife isn't so right now we're literally decorating a Christmas tree with Jewish stars draped around it.
author: Max Greenfield

quote: I think I'm going to give my baby her first food on Thanksgiving, make her some organic sweet potato. I'm very excited! It's going to be a big day and my husband is in charge of the turkey - he's the chef of the family!
author: Lily Aldridge
